You are solving the Travelling Salesman Problem (TSP) in C++.

You must write a C++ solver that can handle ANY number of cities from trivial to ludicrous scale:
- **Trivial**: 10-40 cities (brute-force feasible for smallest cases)
- **Medium**: 100-1000 cities (requires heuristics)
- **Large**: 5000-100000 cities (requires efficient heuristics)
- **Extreme**: 500000-5000000 cities (requires very fast approximations)
- **Epic**: 10000000+ cities (requires highly optimized approximations)

**The Challenge:**
Your program will be tested with city counts ranging from 10 to 10000000. The same algorithm must work efficiently across ALL scales.

**Input format (stdin):**
Line 1: N (number of cities)
Lines 2..N+1: x y coordinates (floats)

**Output format (stdout):**
One line with N integers: the visit order of city indices (0-indexed), starting at city 0.
Do NOT include returning to city 0 (return is implicit).

**Critical Requirements:**
1. **Scalability**: Your algorithm must adapt based on problem size
2. **Performance**: Must complete within 300 seconds even for 1000,000,000 cities
3. **Quality**: Should produce reasonable routes at all scales
4. **Correctness**: Output must be a valid permutation of 0..N-1 starting with 0

Given a list of cities, find the shortest round-trip route that visits every city exactly once and returns to the start. This is one of the most famous hard problems in computer science — checking every possible route is only feasible for a handful of cities, so the AI must use clever shortcuts to find a good route quickly.

Subpasses scale from 10 cities up to 1 000, so brute-force is impossible for the larger cases. The AI's route length is compared against a simple baseline; beating it earns full marks.

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdint>
#include <execution>

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <io.h>
#endif

using namespace std;

const int BUF_SIZE = 1 << 26; // 67 MB
char buf[BUF_SIZE];
int buf_ptr = 0;
int buf_size = 0;

inline char next_char() {
    if (buf_ptr == buf_size) {
        buf_size = (int)fread(buf, 1, BUF_SIZE, stdin);
        buf_ptr = 0;
        if (buf_size == 0) return EOF;
    }
    return buf[buf_ptr++];
}

inline bool read_int(int &x) {
    char c = next_char();
    while (c != EOF && c <= ' ') c = next_char();
    if (c == EOF) return false;
    bool neg = false;
    if (c == '-') { neg = true; c = next_char(); }
    x = 0;
    while (c > ' ') {
        x = x * 10 + (c - '0');
        c = next_char();
    }
    if (neg) x = -x;
    return true;
}

inline bool read_float(float &x) {
    char c = next_char();
    while (c != EOF && c <= ' ') c = next_char();
    if (c == EOF) return false;
    bool neg = false;
    if (c == '-') { neg = true; c = next_char(); }
    double res = 0;
    while (c > ' ' && c != '.' && c != 'e' && c != 'E') {
        res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
        c = next_char();
    }
    if (c == '.') {
        c = next_char();
        double frac = 1;
        while (c > ' ' && c != 'e' && c != 'E') {
            frac *= 0.1;
            res += (c - '0') * frac;
            c = next_char();
        }
    }
    int exp = 0;
    if (c == 'e' || c == 'E') {
        c = next_char();
        bool exp_neg = false;
        if (c == '-') { exp_neg = true; c = next_char(); }
        else if (c == '+') { c = next_char(); }
        while (c > ' ') {
            exp = exp * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = next_char();
        }
        if (exp_neg) exp = -exp;
    }
    if (exp != 0) {
        res *= std::pow(10.0, exp);
    }
    x = neg ? (float)-res : (float)res;
    return true;
}

char out_buf[BUF_SIZE];
int out_ptr = 0;

inline void flush_out() {
    if (out_ptr > 0) {
        fwrite(out_buf, 1, out_ptr, stdout);
        out_ptr = 0;
    }
}

inline void write_int(int x) {
    if (x == 0) {
        if (out_ptr + 2 > BUF_SIZE) flush_out();
        out_buf[out_ptr++] = '0';
        out_buf[out_ptr++] = ' ';
        return;
    }
    char temp[12];
    int t_ptr = 0;
    while (x > 0) {
        temp[t_ptr++] = '0' + (x % 10);
        x /= 10;
    }
    if (out_ptr + t_ptr + 1 > BUF_SIZE) flush_out();
    while (t_ptr > 0) {
        out_buf[out_ptr++] = temp[--t_ptr];
    }
    out_buf[out_ptr++] = ' ';
}

inline uint64_t hilbert(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint64_t d = 0;
    for (int s = 23; s >= 0; s--) {
        uint32_t rx = (x >> s) & 1;
        uint32_t ry = (y >> s) & 1;
        d += ((uint64_t)((3 * rx) ^ ry)) << (2 * s);
        if (ry == 0) {
            if (rx == 1) {
                x = ~x;
                y = ~y;
            }
            uint32_t t = x;
            x = y;
            y = t;
        }
    }
    return d;
}

struct Element {
    uint64_t h;
    int id;
    bool operator<(const Element& other) const {
        return h < other.h;
    }
};

int main() {
#ifdef _WIN32
    _setmode(_fileno(stdin), _O_BINARY);
    _setmode(_fileno(stdout), _O_BINARY);
#endif
    auto start_time = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
    auto elapsed = [&]() {
        auto now = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::duration<double>>(now - start_time).count();
    };

    int N;
    if (!read_int(N)) return 0;

    std::vector<float> X(N);
    std::vector<float> Y(N);
    float min_x = 1e30f, max_x = -1e30f;
    float min_y = 1e30f, max_y = -1e30f;

    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        read_float(X[i]);
        read_float(Y[i]);
        if (X[i] < min_x) min_x = X[i];
        if (X[i] > max_x) max_x = X[i];
        if (Y[i] < min_y) min_y = Y[i];
        if (Y[i] > max_y) max_y = Y[i];
    }

    std::vector<int> ids(N);
    bool do_2opt = (N <= 2000000);

    if (N <= 2000) {
        std::vector<bool> visited(N, false);
        ids[0] = 0;
        visited[0] = true;
        int curr = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < N; ++i) {
            int best_next = -1;
            float best_d = 1e30f;
            float cx = X[curr];
            float cy = Y[curr];
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (!visited[j]) {
                    float dx = X[j] - cx;
                    float dy = Y[j] - cy;
                    float d = dx*dx + dy*dy;
                    if (d < best_d) {
                        best_d = d;
                        best_next = j;
                    }
                }
            }
            ids[i] = best_next;
            visited[best_next] = true;
            curr = best_next;
        }
    } else {
        std::vector<Element> elements(N);
        float range_x = max_x - min_x;
        float range_y = max_y - min_y;
        float scale_x = range_x > 0 ? (16777215.0f / range_x) : 0;
        float scale_y = range_y > 0 ? (16777215.0f / range_y) : 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            uint32_t ix = (uint32_t)((X[i] - min_x) * scale_x);
            uint32_t iy = (uint32_t)((Y[i] - min_y) * scale_y);
            if (ix > 16777215) ix = 16777215;
            if (iy > 16777215) iy = 16777215;
            elements[i].h = hilbert(ix, iy);
            elements[i].id = i;
        }

        if (!do_2opt) {
            std::vector<float>().swap(X);
            std::vector<float>().swap(Y);
        }

        std::sort(std::execution::par, elements.begin(), elements.end());

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            ids[i] = elements[i].id;
        }
        std::vector<Element>().swap(elements);
    }

    if (do_2opt) {
        int window_size = 50;
        if (N <= 2000) window_size = N;
        else if (N <= 10000) window_size = 600;
        else if (N <= 100000) window_size = 200;
        else if (N <= 500000) window_size = 80;
        else window_size = 40;

        auto dist = [&](int a, int b) {
            float dx = X[a] - X[b];
            float dy = Y[a] - Y[b];
            return std::sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
        };

        bool improvement = true;
        int passes = 0;
        while (improvement && passes < 15 && elapsed() < 280.0) {
            improvement = false;
            passes++;
            for (int i = 0; i < N - 2; ++i) {
                int max_j = std::min(N - 1, i + window_size);
                for (int j = i + 2; j < max_j; ++j) {
                    float d1 = dist(ids[i], ids[j]);
                    float d2 = dist(ids[i+1], ids[j+1]);
                    float d3 = dist(ids[i], ids[i+1]);
                    float d4 = dist(ids[j], ids[j+1]);
                    if (d1 + d2 < d3 + d4 - 1e-5f) {
                        std::reverse(ids.begin() + i + 1, ids.begin() + j + 1);
                        improvement = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (passes % 2 == 1 && N > 2) {
                std::rotate(ids.begin(), ids.begin() + N / 2, ids.end());
                improvement = true;
            }
        }
        
        std::vector<float>().swap(X);
        std::vector<float>().swap(Y);
    }

    int start_idx = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        if (ids[i] == 0) {
            start_idx = i;
            break;
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        int idx = start_idx + i;
        if (idx >= N) idx -= N;
        write_int(ids[idx]);
    }

    flush_out();
    return 0;
}

using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Collections.Generic;

class Program
{
    struct EdgeInfo {
        public int u, v, w, id;
    }

    struct MultiEdge {
        public int to, id;
    }

    struct Pair : IComparable<Pair> {
        public int i, j;
        public long dist;
        public int CompareTo(Pair other) {
            int c = dist.CompareTo(other.dist);
            if (c != 0) return c;
            c = i.CompareTo(other.i);
            if (c != 0) return c;
            return j.CompareTo(other.j);
        }
    }

    class FastScanner
    {
        private Stream stream;
        private byte[] buffer = new byte[32768];
        private int head = 0;
        private int tail = 0;

        public FastScanner(Stream stream)
        {
            this.stream = stream;
        }

        private int Read()
        {
            if (head >= tail)
            {
                head = 0;
                tail = stream.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);
                if (tail == 0) return -1;
            }
            return buffer[head++];
        }

        public int NextInt()
        {
            int c = Read();
            while (c <= 32)
            {
                if (c == -1) return -1;
                c = Read();
            }
            bool minus = false;
            if (c == '-')
            {
                minus = true;
                c = Read();
            }
            int res = 0;
            while (c > 32)
            {
                res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
                c = Read();
            }
            return minus ? -res : res;
        }
    }

    static void Main()
    {
        using Stream inputStream = Console.OpenStandardInput();
        FastScanner scanner = new FastScanner(inputStream);

        int N = scanner.NextInt();
        if (N == -1) return; // EOF
        int M = scanner.NextInt();

        EdgeInfo[] originalEdges = new EdgeInfo[M];
        int[] degree = new int[N];

        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++)
        {
            int u = scanner.NextInt();
            int v = scanner.NextInt();
            int w = scanner.NextInt();
            originalEdges[i] = new EdgeInfo { u = u, v = v, w = w, id = i };
            degree[u]++;
            degree[v]++;
        }

        List<int> oddNodes = new List<int>();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        {
            if (degree[i] % 2 != 0)
            {
                oddNodes.Add(i);
            }
        }

        int K = oddNodes.Count;
        List<EdgeInfo> duplicatedEdges = new List<EdgeInfo>();

        if (K > 0)
        {
            if (K <= 20)
            {
                RunExactDP(N, M, K, originalEdges, oddNodes, duplicatedEdges);
            }
            else if ((long)K * M <= 20_000_000)
            {
                RunGreedy(N, M, K, originalEdges, oddNodes, duplicatedEdges);
            }
            else
            {
                RunMST(N, M, originalEdges, degree, duplicatedEdges);
            }
        }

        RunHierholzer(N, M, originalEdges, duplicatedEdges);
    }

    static void BuildAdj(int N, int M, EdgeInfo[] originalEdges, out List<EdgeInfo>[] adj)
    {
        adj = new List<EdgeInfo>[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) adj[i] = new List<EdgeInfo>();
        foreach (var e in originalEdges)
        {
            adj[e.u].Add(new EdgeInfo { u = e.u, v = e.v, w = e.w, id = e.id });
            adj[e.v].Add(new EdgeInfo { u = e.v, v = e.u, w = e.w, id = e.id });
        }
    }

    static void RunDijkstra(int N, int startNode, List<EdgeInfo>[] adj, out long[] dist, out int[] prevEdge)
    {
        dist = new long[N];
        Array.Fill(dist, long.MaxValue);
        prevEdge = new int[N];
        Array.Fill(prevEdge, -1);
        
        var pq = new PriorityQueue<int, long>();
        dist[startNode] = 0;
        pq.Enqueue(startNode, 0);
        
        while (pq.Count > 0)
        {
            pq.TryDequeue(out int u, out long d);
            if (d > dist[u]) continue;
            
            foreach (var edge in adj[u])
            {
                if (dist[u] + edge.w < dist[edge.to])
                {
                    dist[edge.to] = dist[u] + edge.w;
                    prevEdge[edge.to] = edge.id;
                    pq.Enqueue(edge.to, dist[edge.to]);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void RunExactDP(int N, int M, int K, EdgeInfo[] originalEdges, List<int> oddNodes, List<EdgeInfo> duplicatedEdges)
    {
        BuildAdj(N, M, originalEdges, out var adj);
        long[][] distFromOdd = new long[K][];
        int[][] prevFromOdd = new int[K][];
        
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            RunDijkstra(N, oddNodes[i], adj, out distFromOdd[i], out prevFromOdd[i]);
        }
        
        long[] dp = new long[1 << K];
        Array.Fill(dp, long.MaxValue);
        dp[0] = 0;
        
        int[] parentMask = new int[1 << K];
        int[] matchI = new int[1 << K];
        int[] matchJ = new int[1 << K];
        
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << K); mask++) {
            if (dp[mask] == long.MaxValue) continue;
            
            int i = -1;
            for (int bit = 0; bit < K; bit++) {
                if ((mask & (1 << bit)) == 0) {
                    i = bit;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (i == -1) continue;
            
            for (int j = i + 1; j < K; j++) {
                if ((mask & (1 << j)) == 0) {
                    if (distFromOdd[i][oddNodes[j]] != long.MaxValue) {
                        int newMask = mask | (1 << i) | (1 << j);
                        long newCost = dp[mask] + distFromOdd[i][oddNodes[j]];
                        if (newCost < dp[newMask]) {
                            dp[newMask] = newCost;
                            parentMask[newMask] = mask;
                            matchI[newMask] = i;
                            matchJ[newMask] = j;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int currMask = (1 << K) - 1;
        while (currMask > 0) {
            int i = matchI[currMask];
            int j = matchJ[currMask];
            
            int currNode = oddNodes[j];
            int startNode = oddNodes[i];
            while (currNode != startNode) {
                int edgeId = prevFromOdd[i][currNode];
                EdgeInfo e = originalEdges[edgeId];
                duplicatedEdges.Add(e);
                currNode = (e.u == currNode) ? e.v : e.u;
            }
            
            currMask = parentMask[currMask];
        }
    }

    static void RunGreedy(int N, int M, int K, EdgeInfo[] originalEdges, List<int> oddNodes, List<EdgeInfo> duplicatedEdges)
    {
        BuildAdj(N, M, originalEdges, out var adj);
        long[][] distFromOdd = new long[K][];
        int[][] prevFromOdd = new int[K][];
        
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            RunDijkstra(N, oddNodes[i], adj, out distFromOdd[i], out prevFromOdd[i]);
        }
        
        List<Pair> pairs = new List<Pair>();
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < K; j++) {
                if (distFromOdd[i][oddNodes[j]] != long.MaxValue) {
                    pairs.Add(new Pair { i = i, j = j, dist = distFromOdd[i][oddNodes[j]] });
                }
            }
        }
        pairs.Sort();
        
        bool[] matched = new bool[K];
        foreach (var pair in pairs) {
            if (!matched[pair.i] && !matched[pair.j]) {
                matched[pair.i] = true;
                matched[pair.j] = true;
                
                int currNode = oddNodes[pair.j];
                int startNode = oddNodes[pair.i];
                while (currNode != startNode) {
                    int edgeId = prevFromOdd[pair.i][currNode];
                    EdgeInfo e = originalEdges[edgeId];
                    duplicatedEdges.Add(e);
                    currNode = (e.u == currNode) ? e.v : e.u;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void RunMST(int N, int M, EdgeInfo[] originalEdges, int[] degree, List<EdgeInfo> duplicatedEdges)
    {
        int[] weights = new int[M];
        int[] edgeIndices = new int[M];
        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            weights[i] = originalEdges[i].w;
            edgeIndices[i] = i;
        }
        
        Array.Sort(weights, edgeIndices);
        
        int[] parentUF = new int[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) parentUF[i] = i;
        
        int Find(int i) {
            int root = i;
            while (root != parentUF[root]) root = parentUF[root];
            int curr = i;
            while (curr != root) {
                int nxt = parentUF[curr];
                parentUF[curr] = root;
                curr = nxt;
            }
            return root;
        }
        
        void Union(int i, int j) {
            int rootI = Find(i);
            int rootJ = Find(j);
            if (rootI != rootJ) parentUF[rootI] = rootJ;
        }
        
        List<EdgeInfo>[] treeAdj = new List<EdgeInfo>[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) treeAdj[i] = new List<EdgeInfo>();
        
        foreach (int id in edgeIndices) {
            EdgeInfo e = originalEdges[id];
            if (Find(e.u) != Find(e.v)) {
                Union(e.u, e.v);
                treeAdj[e.u].Add(e);
                treeAdj[e.v].Add(e);
            }
        }
        
        bool[] parity = new bool[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) parity[i] = (degree[i] % 2 != 0);
        
        bool[] visited = new bool[N];
        int[] parent = new int[N];
        int[] order = new int[N];
        int orderIdx = 0;
        int[] q = new int[N];
        
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            if (!visited[i] && treeAdj[i].Count > 0) {
                int head = 0, tail = 0;
                q[tail++] = i;
                visited[i] = true;
                parent[i] = -1;
                
                while (head < tail) {
                    int u = q[head++];
                    order[orderIdx++] = u;
                    
                    foreach (var e in treeAdj[u]) {
                        int v = (e.u == u) ? e.v : e.u;
                        if (!visited[v]) {
                            visited[v] = true;
                            parent[v] = u;
                            q[tail++] = v;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = orderIdx - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            int u = order[i];
            if (parent[u] != -1 && parity[u]) {
                EdgeInfo pEdge = default;
                foreach (var e in treeAdj[u]) {
                    int v = (e.u == u) ? e.v : e.u;
                    if (v == parent[u]) {
                        pEdge = e;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                duplicatedEdges.Add(pEdge);
                parity[u] = !parity[u];
                parity[parent[u]] = !parity[parent[u]];
            }
        }
    }

    static void RunHierholzer(int N, int M, EdgeInfo[] originalEdges, List<EdgeInfo> duplicatedEdges)
    {
        if (M == 0) {
            Console.WriteLine(0);
            return;
        }
        
        List<MultiEdge>[] multiAdj = new List<MultiEdge>[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) multiAdj[i] = new List<MultiEdge>();
        
        int nextEdgeId = 0;
        void AddMulti(int u, int v) {
            multiAdj[u].Add(new MultiEdge { to = v, id = nextEdgeId });
            multiAdj[v].Add(new MultiEdge { to = u, id = nextEdgeId });
            nextEdgeId++;
        }
        
        foreach (var e in originalEdges) AddMulti(e.u, e.v);
        foreach (var e in duplicatedEdges) AddMulti(e.u, e.v);
        
        bool[] used = new bool[nextEdgeId];
        int[] head = new int[N];
        
        Stack<int> currPath = new Stack<int>();
        List<int> circuit = new List<int>();
        
        currPath.Push(0);
        while (currPath.Count > 0)
        {
            int u = currPath.Peek();
            bool found = false;
            while (head[u] < multiAdj[u].Count)
            {
                var edge = multiAdj[u][head[u]];
                head[u]++;
                if (!used[edge.id])
                {
                    used[edge.id] = true;
                    currPath.Push(edge.to);
                    found = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!found)
            {
                circuit.Add(u);
                currPath.Pop();
            }
        }
        
        circuit.Reverse();
        
        using (StreamWriter sw = new StreamWriter(Console.OpenStandardOutput(), bufferSize: 65536))
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < circuit.Count; i++)
            {
                sw.Write(circuit[i]);
                if (i < circuit.Count - 1) sw.Write(' ');
            }
            sw.WriteLine();
        }
    }
}

use std::io::{self, Read, Write, BufWriter};

#[derive(Clone, Default)]
struct QuadNode {
    mass: f64,
    cx: f64,
    cy: f64,
    min_x: f64,
    max_x: f64,
    min_y: f64,
    max_y: f64,
    children: [usize; 4],
}

fn partition4(points: &mut [usize], pos: &[(f64, f64)], mid_x: f64, mid_y: f64) -> [usize; 5] {
    let mut bounds = [0; 5];
    bounds[0] = 0;
    
    let mut i = 0;
    let mut j = points.len();
    while i < j {
        if pos[points[i]].1 < mid_y { i += 1; }
        else { j -= 1; points.swap(i, j); }
    }
    let mid_split = i; 
    
    let mut i = 0;
    let mut j = mid_split;
    while i < j {
        if pos[points[i]].0 < mid_x { i += 1; }
        else { j -= 1; points.swap(i, j); }
    }
    bounds[1] = i; 
    bounds[2] = mid_split; 
    
    let mut i = mid_split;
    let mut j = points.len();
    while i < j {
        if pos[points[i]].0 < mid_x { i += 1; }
        else { j -= 1; points.swap(i, j); }
    }
    bounds[3] = i; 
    bounds[4] = points.len(); 
    
    bounds
}

fn split_4<'a>(points: &'a mut [usize], bounds: &[usize; 5]) -> [&'a mut [usize]; 4] {
    let (p0, rest) = points.split_at_mut(bounds[1]);
    let (p1, rest) = rest.split_at_mut(bounds[2] - bounds[1]);
    let (p2, p3) = rest.split_at_mut(bounds[3] - bounds[2]);
    [p0, p1, p2, p3]
}

fn build_tree(
    points: &mut [usize], 
    pos: &[(f64, f64)], 
    min_x: f64, max_x: f64, min_y: f64, max_y: f64, 
    nodes: &mut Vec<QuadNode>,
    depth: usize
) -> Option<usize> {
    if points.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    
    let mut coincident = true;
    let first_p = pos[points[0]];
    for &p in points.iter().skip(1) {
        if (pos[p].0 - first_p.0).abs() > 1e-5 || (pos[p].1 - first_p.1).abs() > 1e-5 {
            coincident = false;
            break;
        }
    }
    
    if points.len() == 1 || depth > 40 || coincident {
        let mut sum_x = 0.0;
        let mut sum_y = 0.0;
        for &p in points.iter() {
            sum_x += pos[p].0;
            sum_y += pos[p].1;
        }
        let mass = points.len() as f64;
        let node_idx = nodes.len();
        nodes.push(QuadNode {
            mass,
            cx: sum_x / mass,
            cy: sum_y / mass,
            min_x, max_x, min_y, max_y,
            children: [usize::MAX; 4],
        });
        return Some(node_idx);
    }
    
    let mid_x = (min_x + max_x) / 2.0;
    let mid_y = (min_y + max_y) / 2.0;
    
    let bounds = partition4(points, pos, mid_x, mid_y);
    let mut subs = split_4(points, &bounds);
    
    let mut children = [usize::MAX; 4];
    let mut mass = 0.0;
    let mut cx_sum = 0.0;
    let mut cy_sum = 0.0;
    
    for c in 0..4 {
        let (nx1, nx2) = if c % 2 == 0 { (min_x, mid_x) } else { (mid_x, max_x) };
        let (ny1, ny2) = if c / 2 == 0 { (min_y, mid_y) } else { (mid_y, max_y) };
        if let Some(child_idx) = build_tree(subs[c], pos, nx1, nx2, ny1, ny2, nodes, depth + 1) {
            children[c] = child_idx;
            let m = nodes[child_idx].mass;
            mass += m;
            cx_sum += nodes[child_idx].cx * m;
            cy_sum += nodes[child_idx].cy * m;
        }
    }
    
    let node_idx = nodes.len();
    nodes.push(QuadNode {
        mass,
        cx: cx_sum / mass,
        cy: cy_sum / mass,
        min_x, max_x, min_y, max_y,
        children,
    });
    
    Some(node_idx)
}

fn compute_repulsion(
    node_idx: usize, 
    p: usize, 
    pos: &[(f64, f64)], 
    nodes: &[QuadNode], 
    theta: f64,
    k: f64
) -> (f64, f64) {
    let node = &nodes[node_idx];
    let dx = node.cx - pos[p].0;
    let dy = node.cy - pos[p].1;
    let mut dist_sq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    
    let is_leaf = node.children == [usize::MAX; 4];
    let width = node.max_x - node.min_x;
    
    if is_leaf || (width / dist_sq.sqrt().max(1e-5)) < theta {
        let mut m = node.mass;
        if is_leaf && dist_sq < 1e-5 {
            m -= 1.0;
            if m <= 0.0 {
                return (0.0, 0.0);
            }
            let angle = (p as f64).sin() * 100.0;
            return (k * angle.cos(), k * angle.sin());
        }
        
        let dist = dist_sq.sqrt().max(1e-5);
        let f = (k * k) * m / (dist * dist);
        return (-dx * f, -dy * f);
    }
    
    let mut fx = 0.0;
    let mut fy = 0.0;
    for &child_idx in &node.children {
        if child_idx != usize::MAX {
            let (cfx, cfy) = compute_repulsion(child_idx, p, pos, nodes, theta, k);
            fx += cfx;
            fy += cfy;
        }
    }
    (fx, fy)
}

fn find_components(n: usize, edges: &[(usize, usize)]) -> Vec<Vec<usize>> {
    let mut adj = vec![vec![]; n];
    for &(u, v) in edges {
        adj[u].push(v);
        adj[v].push(u);
    }
    
    let mut visited = vec![false; n];
    let mut components = Vec::new();
    
    for i in 0..n {
        if !visited[i] {
            let mut comp = Vec::new();
            let mut q = vec![i];
            visited[i] = true;
            
            while let Some(u) = q.pop() {
                comp.push(u);
                for &v in &adj[u] {
                    if !visited[v] {
                        visited[v] = true;
                        q.push(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            components.push(comp);
        }
    }
    components
}

fn layout_single_component(n: usize, edges: &[(usize, usize)], k: f64) -> Vec<(f64, f64)> {
    if n == 1 {
        return vec![(0.0, 0.0)];
    }
    
    let mut adj = vec![vec![]; n];
    for &(u, v) in edges {
        adj[u].push(v);
        adj[v].push(u);
    }
    
    let mut pos = vec![(0.0, 0.0); n];
    let mut visited = vec![false; n];
    let mut layers = Vec::new();
    
    let start_node = (0..n).max_by_key(|&i| adj[i].len()).unwrap_or(0);
    
    let mut current_layer = vec![start_node];
    visited[start_node] = true;
    let mut next_layer = Vec::new();
    
    while !current_layer.is_empty() {
        layers.push(current_layer.clone());
        for &u in &current_layer {
            for &v in &adj[u] {
                if !visited[v] {
                    visited[v] = true;
                    next_layer.push(v);
                }
            }
        }
        current_layer = next_layer;
        next_layer = Vec::new();
    }
    
    let mut current_radius = 0.0;
    for layer in layers {
        let count = layer.len();
        if count == 1 {
            pos[layer[0]] = (current_radius, 0.0);
        } else {
            let angle_step = std::f64::consts::TAU / (count as f64);
            for (i, &u) in layer.iter().enumerate() {
                let angle = i as f64 * angle_step;
                pos[u] = (current_radius * angle.cos(), current_radius * angle.sin());
            }
        }
        current_radius += k;
    }
    
    let theta = if n > 50000 { 1.5 } else if n > 10000 { 1.2 } else { 0.9 };
    let iters = if n > 100000 { 60 } else if n > 50000 { 80 } else if n > 10000 { 120 } else { 200 };
    
    let mut temp = 5.0 * k;
    let temp_step = temp / (iters as f64);
    
    let mut disp = vec![(0.0, 0.0); n];
    let mut points: Vec<usize> = (0..n).collect();
    let mut nodes = Vec::with_capacity(n * 4);
    
    for _iter in 0..iters {
        disp.fill((0.0, 0.0));
        
        let mut min_x = f64::MAX;
        let mut max_x = f64::MIN;
        let mut min_y = f64::MAX;
        let mut max_y = f64::MIN;
        
        for &(x, y) in &pos {
            if x < min_x { min_x = x; }
            if x > max_x { max_x = x; }
            if y < min_y { min_y = y; }
            if y > max_y { max_y = y; }
        }
        
        min_x -= 1.0; max_x += 1.0;
        min_y -= 1.0; max_y += 1.0;
        
        nodes.clear();
        for i in 0..n { points[i] = i; }
        
        let root = build_tree(&mut points, &pos, min_x, max_x, min_y, max_y, &mut nodes, 0);
        
        if let Some(root_idx) = root {
            for i in 0..n {
                let (mut fx, mut fy) = compute_repulsion(root_idx, i, &pos, &nodes, theta, k);
                
                let gx = 0.0 - pos[i].0;
                let gy = 0.0 - pos[i].1;
                fx += 0.01 * gx;
                fy += 0.01 * gy;
                
                disp[i].0 += fx;
                disp[i].1 += fy;
            }
        }
        
        for &(u, v) in edges {
            let dx = pos[v].0 - pos[u].0;
            let dy = pos[v].1 - pos[u].1;
            let dist_sq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
            let dist = dist_sq.sqrt().max(1e-5);
            let f = dist / k;
            let fx = dx * f;
            let fy = dy * f;
            
            disp[u].0 += fx;
            disp[u].1 += fy;
            disp[v].0 -= fx;
            disp[v].1 -= fy;
        }
        
        for i in 0..n {
            let dx = disp[i].0;
            let dy = disp[i].1;
            let d_len = (dx * dx + dy * dy).sqrt().max(1e-5);
            let limit = temp.min(d_len);
            pos[i].0 += (dx / d_len) * limit;
            pos[i].1 += (dy / d_len) * limit;
        }
        
        temp -= temp_step;
        if temp < 0.1 { temp = 0.1; }
    }
    
    pos
}

fn main() {
    let mut input = String::new();
    io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut input).unwrap();
    let mut tokens = input.split_whitespace();
    
    let n_token = tokens.next();
    if n_token.is_none() {
        return;
    }
    let n: usize = n_token.unwrap().parse().unwrap();
    let m: usize = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
    
    let mut edges = Vec::with_capacity(m);
    for _ in 0..m {
        let u: usize = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
        let v: usize = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
        edges.push((u, v));
    }
    
    let components = find_components(n, &edges);
    
    let mut comp_id = vec![0; n];
    for (id, comp) in components.iter().enumerate() {
        for &u in comp {
            comp_id[u] = id;
        }
    }
    
    let mut comp_edges = vec![vec![]; components.len()];
    for &(u, v) in &edges {
        if comp_id[u] == comp_id[v] {
            comp_edges[comp_id[u]].push((u, v));
        }
    }
    
    let mut pos = vec![(0.0, 0.0); n];
    let k = 10.0;
    
    let mut global_to_local = vec![usize::MAX; n];
    
    for (id, comp) in components.iter().enumerate() {
        for (local_u, &global_u) in comp.iter().enumerate() {
            global_to_local[global_u] = local_u;
        }
        
        let edges_local = comp_edges[id].iter()
            .map(|&(u, v)| (global_to_local[u], global_to_local[v]))
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
            
        let pos_local = layout_single_component(comp.len(), &edges_local, k);
        
        for (local_u, &global_u) in comp.iter().enumerate() {
            pos[global_u] = pos_local[local_u];
        }
    }
    
    let mut component_boxes = Vec::new();
    for (id, comp) in components.iter().enumerate() {
        let mut min_x = f64::MAX;
        let mut max_x = f64::MIN;
        let mut min_y = f64::MAX;
        let mut max_y = f64::MIN;
        for &u in comp {
            let (x, y) = pos[u];
            if x < min_x { min_x = x; }
            if x > max_x { max_x = x; }
            if y < min_y { min_y = y; }
            if y > max_y { max_y = y; }
        }
        
        if min_x > max_x {
            min_x = 0.0; max_x = 0.0;
            min_y = 0.0; max_y = 0.0;
        }
        
        let width = max_x - min_x + k;
        let height = max_y - min_y + k;
        component_boxes.push((id, width, height, min_x, max_x, min_y, max_y));
    }
    
    component_boxes.sort_by(|a, b| b.2.partial_cmp(&a.2).unwrap());
    
    let max_width = 100.0 * k * (components.len() as f64).sqrt().max(1.0);
    let mut current_x = 0.0;
    let mut current_y = 0.0;
    let mut row_height = 0.0;
    
    let mut offsets = vec![(0.0, 0.0); components.len()];
    
    for &(id, width, height, min_x, max_x, min_y, max_y) in &component_boxes {
        if current_x + width > max_width && current_x > 0.0 {
            current_x = 0.0;
            current_y += row_height;
            row_height = 0.0;
        }
        
        offsets[id] = (current_x - min_x + k/2.0, current_y - min_y + k/2.0);
        
        current_x += width;
        if height > row_height {
            row_height = height;
        }
    }
    
    for (id, comp) in components.iter().enumerate() {
        let (ox, oy) = offsets[id];
        for &u in comp {
            pos[u].0 += ox;
            pos[u].1 += oy;
        }
    }
    
    let stdout = io::stdout();
    let mut writer = BufWriter::new(stdout.lock());
    for &(x, y) in &pos {
        writeln!(writer, "{:.6} {:.6}", x, y).unwrap();
    }
}

use std::io::{self, Read};
use std::collections::{HashSet, HashMap, VecDeque};

struct FastBFS {
    visited: Vec<u32>,
    generation: u32,
    queue: Vec<usize>,
}

impl FastBFS {
    fn new(v: usize) -> Self {
        FastBFS {
            visited: vec![0; v],
            generation: 0,
            queue: Vec::with_capacity(v),
        }
    }
    fn is_connected(&mut self, start: usize, expected_count: usize, adj: &[Vec<usize>], node_visited: &[bool]) -> bool {
        if expected_count <= 1 {
            return true;
        }
        self.generation += 1;
        self.queue.clear();
        self.queue.push(start);
        self.visited[start] = self.generation;
        let mut count = 1;

        let mut head = 0;
        while head < self.queue.len() {
            let u = self.queue[head];
            head += 1;

            for i in 0..adj[u].len() {
                let v = adj[u][i];
                if !node_visited[v] && self.visited[v] != self.generation {
                    self.visited[v] = self.generation;
                    self.queue.push(v);
                    count += 1;
                }
            }
        }
        count == expected_count
    }
}

struct Solver {
    adj: Vec<Vec<usize>>,
    color: Vec<usize>,
    visited: Vec<bool>,
    unvisited_count: usize,
    unvisited_colors: [usize; 2],
    deg: Vec<usize>,
    deg1_count: usize,
    deg1_xor: usize,
    deg0_count: usize,
    start_node: usize,
    require_cycle: bool,
    is_adj_to_start: Vec<bool>,
    path: Vec<usize>,
}

impl Solver {
    fn move_forward(&mut self, w: usize) {
        self.visited[w] = true;
        self.unvisited_count -= 1;
        self.unvisited_colors[self.color[w]] -= 1;

        let d_w = self.deg[w];
        if d_w == 1 {
            self.deg1_count -= 1;
            self.deg1_xor ^= w;
        } else if d_w == 0 {
            self.deg0_count -= 1;
        }

        for i in 0..self.adj[w].len() {
            let n = self.adj[w][i];
            if !self.visited[n] {
                let d = self.deg[n];
                if d == 1 {
                    self.deg1_count -= 1;
                    self.deg1_xor ^= n;
                    self.deg0_count += 1;
                } else if d == 2 {
                    self.deg1_count += 1;
                    self.deg1_xor ^= n;
                }
                self.deg[n] -= 1;
            }
        }
    }

    fn move_backward(&mut self, w: usize) {
        for i in 0..self.adj[w].len() {
            let n = self.adj[w][i];
            if !self.visited[n] {
                self.deg[n] += 1;
                let d = self.deg[n];
                if d == 1 {
                    self.deg0_count -= 1;
                    self.deg1_count += 1;
                    self.deg1_xor ^= n;
                } else if d == 2 {
                    self.deg1_count -= 1;
                    self.deg1_xor ^= n;
                }
            }
        }

        let d_w = self.deg[w];
        if d_w == 1 {
            self.deg1_count += 1;
            self.deg1_xor ^= w;
        } else if d_w == 0 {
            self.deg0_count += 1;
        }

        self.visited[w] = false;
        self.unvisited_count += 1;
        self.unvisited_colors[self.color[w]] += 1;
    }

    fn solve(&mut self, u: usize, bfs: &mut FastBFS) -> bool {
        if self.unvisited_count == 0 {
            if self.require_cycle {
                return self.is_adj_to_start[u];
            }
            return true;
        }

        let next_c = 1 - self.color[u];
        let req_next = (self.unvisited_count + 1) / 2;
        let req_other = self.unvisited_count / 2;
        if self.unvisited_colors[next_c] != req_next || self.unvisited_colors[1 - next_c] != req_other {
            return false;
        }

        if self.deg0_count > 0 {
            if self.unvisited_count > 1 {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if self.deg1_count > 2 {
            return false;
        }

        if self.deg1_count == 1 && self.require_cycle {
            if !self.is_adj_to_start[self.deg1_xor] {
                return false;
            }
        }

        let mut moves = Vec::new();
        for &v in &self.adj[u] {
            if !self.visited[v] {
                moves.push(v);
            }
        }

        if moves.is_empty() {
            return false;
        }

        if !bfs.is_connected(moves[0], self.unvisited_count, &self.adj, &self.visited) {
            return false;
        }

        moves.sort_by_key(|&v| self.deg[v]);

        if self.deg1_count == 2 {
            moves.retain(|&v| {
                if self.deg[v] == 1 {
                    if self.require_cycle {
                        let other_d1 = self.deg1_xor ^ v;
                        self.is_adj_to_start[other_d1]
                    } else {
                        true
                    }
                } else {
                    false
                }
            });
            if moves.is_empty() {
                return false;
            }
        }

        for i in 0..moves.len() {
            let v = moves[i];
            self.move_forward(v);
            self.path.push(v);
            
            if self.solve(v, bfs) {
                return true;
            }
            
            self.path.pop();
            self.move_backward(v);
        }

        false
    }
}

fn main() {
    let mut input = String::new();
    if io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut input).is_err() {
        return;
    }
    let mut tokens = input.split_whitespace();
    
    let w_str = tokens.next();
    if w_str.is_none() { return; }
    let W: usize = w_str.unwrap().parse().unwrap();
    let H: usize = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
    let obs_count: usize = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
    let req_cycle_num: usize = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
    let require_cycle = req_cycle_num == 1;

    let total_cells = (W as u64).saturating_mul(H as u64);
    let expected_visits = total_cells.saturating_sub(obs_count as u64);

    let use_dense = total_cells <= 100_000_000;
    let mut dense_grid = Vec::new();
    let mut obs_set = HashSet::new();

    if use_dense {
        dense_grid.resize(total_cells as usize, false);
    }

    for _ in 0..obs_count {
        let x: usize = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
        let y: usize = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
        if use_dense {
            dense_grid[y * W + x] = true;
        } else {
            obs_set.insert((x, y));
        }
    }

    let is_obs = |x: usize, y: usize| -> bool {
        if use_dense {
            dense_grid[y * W + x]
        } else {
            obs_set.contains(&(x, y))
        }
    };

    if expected_visits == 0 || is_obs(0, 0) {
        println!("0");
        return;
    }

    let mut reachable = Vec::new();
    let mut node_idx = HashMap::new();
    let mut dense_idx = Vec::new();
    if use_dense {
        dense_idx.resize(total_cells as usize, usize::MAX);
    }

    let mut queue = VecDeque::new();
    queue.push_back((0, 0));

    if use_dense {
        dense_idx[0] = 0;
    } else {
        node_idx.insert((0, 0), 0);
    }
    reachable.push((0, 0));

    let dx = [0, 1, 0, -1];
    let dy = [1, 0, -1, 0];

    let mut head = 0;
    while head < reachable.len() {
        let (x, y) = reachable[head];
        head += 1;

        for i in 0..4 {
            let nx = x as i32 + dx[i];
            let ny = y as i32 + dy[i];
            if nx >= 0 && nx < W as i32 && ny >= 0 && ny < H as i32 {
                let nux = nx as usize;
                let nuy = ny as usize;
                if !is_obs(nux, nuy) {
                    let visited = if use_dense {
                        dense_idx[nuy * W + nux] != usize::MAX
                    } else {
                        node_idx.contains_key(&(nux, nuy))
                    };
                    
                    if !visited {
                        let id = reachable.len();
                        if use_dense {
                            dense_idx[nuy * W + nux] = id;
                        } else {
                            node_idx.insert((nux, nuy), id);
                        }
                        reachable.push((nux, nuy));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (reachable.len() as u64) != expected_visits {
        println!("0");
        return;
    }

    let V = reachable.len();
    let mut adj = vec![Vec::new(); V];
    for i in 0..V {
        let (x, y) = reachable[i];
        for dir in 0..4 {
            let nx = x as i32 + dx[dir];
            let ny = y as i32 + dy[dir];
            if nx >= 0 && nx < W as i32 && ny >= 0 && ny < H as i32 {
                let nux = nx as usize;
                let nuy = ny as usize;
                if use_dense {
                    let id = dense_idx[nuy * W + nux];
                    if id != usize::MAX {
                        adj[i].push(id);
                    }
                } else {
                    if let Some(&id) = node_idx.get(&(nux, nuy)) {
                        adj[i].push(id);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    let mut solver = Solver {
        adj: adj.clone(),
        color: vec![0; V],
        visited: vec![false; V],
        unvisited_count: V,
        unvisited_colors: [0, 0],
        deg: vec![0; V],
        deg1_count: 0,
        deg1_xor: 0,
        deg0_count: 0,
        start_node: 0,
        require_cycle,
        is_adj_to_start: vec![false; V],
        path: Vec::with_capacity(V),
    };

    for i in 0..V {
        solver.deg[i] = solver.adj[i].len();
        let (x, y) = reachable[i];
        solver.color[i] = (x + y) % 2;
        solver.unvisited_colors[solver.color[i]] += 1;
    }

    for i in 0..V {
        if solver.deg[i] == 1 {
            solver.deg1_count += 1;
            solver.deg1_xor ^= i;
        } else if solver.deg[i] == 0 {
            solver.deg0_count += 1;
        }
    }

    for &v in &solver.adj[0] {
        solver.is_adj_to_start[v] = true;
    }

    if solver.unvisited_count > 1 && solver.deg0_count > 0 {
        println!("0");
        return;
    }

    if require_cycle && solver.unvisited_colors[0] != solver.unvisited_colors[1] {
        println!("0");
        return;
    }

    let diff = (solver.unvisited_colors[0] as i32 - solver.unvisited_colors[1] as i32).abs();
    if !require_cycle && diff > 1 {
        println!("0");
        return;
    }

    solver.move_forward(0);
    solver.path.push(0);

    let mut bfs = FastBFS::new(V);
    
    // Fast initial connectivity check if V > 1
    if solver.unvisited_count > 0 {
        let mut any_unvisited = usize::MAX;
        for i in 0..V {
            if !solver.visited[i] {
                any_unvisited = i;
                break;
            }
        }
        if any_unvisited != usize::MAX {
            if !bfs.is_connected(any_unvisited, solver.unvisited_count, &solver.adj, &solver.visited) {
                println!("0");
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    if !solver.solve(0, &mut bfs) {
        println!("0");
    } else {
        println!("{}", solver.path.len());
        for &u in &solver.path {
            let (x, y) = reachable[u];
            println!("{} {}", x, y);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

class Program
{
    struct Vector3
    {
        public double X, Y, Z;
        public Vector3(double x, double y, double z) { X = x; Y = y; Z = z; }
        public static Vector3 operator -(Vector3 a, Vector3 b) => new Vector3(a.X - b.X, a.Y - b.Y, a.Z - b.Z);
        public static Vector3 operator +(Vector3 a, Vector3 b) => new Vector3(a.X + b.X, a.Y + b.Y, a.Z + b.Z);
        public static Vector3 operator *(Vector3 a, double d) => new Vector3(a.X * d, a.Y * d, a.Z * d);
        public static Vector3 operator /(Vector3 a, double d) => new Vector3(a.X / d, a.Y / d, a.Z / d);
        public double Dot(Vector3 b) => X * b.X + Y * b.Y + Z * b.Z;
        public Vector3 Cross(Vector3 b) => new Vector3(Y * b.Z - Z * b.Y, Z * b.X - X * b.Z, X * b.Y - Y * b.X);
        public double Length() => Math.Sqrt(Dot(this));
    }

    struct Orbit
    {
        public Vector3 R, V;
        public Vector3 H;
        public Vector3 E_vec;
        public double E;
        public double I, RAAN, AOP;
        
        public Orbit(double x, double y, double z, double vx, double vy, double vz, double mu)
        {
            R = new Vector3(x, y, z);
            V = new Vector3(vx, vy, vz);
            H = R.Cross(V);
            E = V.Dot(V) / 2.0 - mu / R.Length();
            E_vec = V.Cross(H) / mu - R / R.Length();
            
            double h_len = H.Length();
            I = h_len > 0 ? Math.Acos(H.Z / h_len) : 0;
            
            Vector3 N_vec = new Vector3(0, 0, 1).Cross(H);
            double n_len = N_vec.Length();
            if (n_len != 0)
            {
                RAAN = Math.Acos(N_vec.X / n_len);
                if (N_vec.Y < 0) RAAN = 2 * Math.PI - RAAN;
            }
            else
            {
                RAAN = 0;
            }
            
            double e_len = E_vec.Length();
            if (n_len != 0 && e_len != 0)
            {
                double dot = N_vec.Dot(E_vec) / (n_len * e_len);
                dot = Math.Max(-1.0, Math.Min(1.0, dot));
                AOP = Math.Acos(dot);
                if (E_vec.Z < 0) AOP = 2 * Math.PI - AOP;
            }
            else
            {
                AOP = 0;
            }
        }
    }

    static double Distance(Orbit a, Orbit b, double mu)
    {
        double dI = Math.Abs(a.I - b.I);
        double dRAAN = Math.Abs(a.RAAN - b.RAAN);
        if (dRAAN > Math.PI) dRAAN = 2 * Math.PI - dRAAN;
        
        double cosDTheta = Math.Cos(a.I) * Math.Cos(b.I) + Math.Sin(a.I) * Math.Sin(b.I) * Math.Cos(dRAAN);
        cosDTheta = Math.Max(-1.0, Math.Min(1.0, cosDTheta));
        double dTheta = Math.Acos(cosDTheta);
        
        double v_avg = (a.V.Length() + b.V.Length()) / 2.0;
        double dv_plane = 2 * v_avg * Math.Sin(dTheta / 2.0);
        
        double val = a.V.Dot(a.V) + 2 * (b.E - a.E);
        double dv_energy = Math.Abs(Math.Sqrt(Math.Max(0, val)) - a.V.Length());
        
        double dEvec = (a.E_vec - b.E_vec).Length();
        double dv_shape = dEvec * v_avg * 0.5;
        
        double dPos = (a.R - b.R).Length() / Math.Max(a.R.Length(), b.R.Length());
        double dv_pos = dPos * v_avg * 0.2;
        
        return dv_plane + dv_energy + dv_shape + dv_pos;
    }

    static void Main()
    {
        string line1Str = Console.ReadLine();
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line1Str)) return;
        string[] line1 = line1Str.Split(new[] { ' ', '\t' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        int N = int.Parse(line1[0]);
        double mu = double.Parse(line1[1]);

        string[] line2 = Console.ReadLine().Split(new[] { ' ', '\t' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        Orbit startOrbit = new Orbit(
            double.Parse(line2[0]), double.Parse(line2[1]), double.Parse(line2[2]),
            double.Parse(line2[3]), double.Parse(line2[4]), double.Parse(line2[5]), mu);

        Orbit[] stations = new Orbit[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        {
            string[] line = Console.ReadLine().Split(new[] { ' ', '\t' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
            stations[i] = new Orbit(
                double.Parse(line[0]), double.Parse(line[1]), double.Parse(line[2]),
                double.Parse(line[3]), double.Parse(line[4]), double.Parse(line[5]), mu);
        }

        double[,] dist = new double[N + 1, N + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        {
            dist[0, i + 1] = Distance(startOrbit, stations[i], mu);
            dist[i + 1, 0] = dist[0, i + 1];
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++)
            {
                dist[i + 1, j + 1] = Distance(stations[i], stations[j], mu);
            }
        }

        List<int> bestPath = null;
        double bestDist = double.MaxValue;
        
        Random rnd = new Random(42);
        int numRestarts = 1000;
        
        for (int restart = 0; restart < numRestarts; restart++)
        {
            List<int> path = new List<int>();
            List<int> unvisited = new List<int>();
            for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) unvisited.Add(i);
            
            int curr = 0;
            if (restart > 0)
            {
                int idx = rnd.Next(unvisited.Count);
                int next = unvisited[idx];
                path.Add(next);
                unvisited.RemoveAt(idx);
                curr = next;
            }
            
            while (unvisited.Count > 0)
            {
                int next = -1;
                double minDist = double.MaxValue;
                foreach (int cand in unvisited)
                {
                    double d = dist[curr, cand];
                    if (restart > 0) d *= (1.0 + (rnd.NextDouble() - 0.5) * 0.1);
                    
                    if (d < minDist)
                    {
                        minDist = d;
                        next = cand;
                    }
                }
                path.Add(next);
                unvisited.Remove(next);
                curr = next;
            }

            bool improved = true;
            while (improved)
            {
                improved = false;
                for (int i = 0; i < path.Count - 1; i++)
                {
                    for (int j = i + 1; j < path.Count; j++)
                    {
                        int node1 = i == 0 ? 0 : path[i - 1];
                        int node2 = path[i];
                        int node3 = path[j];
                        int node4 = j == path.Count - 1 ? -1 : path[j + 1];

                        double currentDist = dist[node1, node2] + (node4 == -1 ? 0 : dist[node3, node4]);
                        double newDist = dist[node1, node3] + (node4 == -1 ? 0 : dist[node2, node4]);

                        if (newDist < currentDist - 1e-9)
                        {
                            path.Reverse(i, j - i + 1);
                            improved = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            double totalDist = 0;
            int prev = 0;
            foreach(int node in path)
            {
                totalDist += dist[prev, node];
                prev = node;
            }
            
            if (totalDist < bestDist)
            {
                bestDist = totalDist;
                bestPath = new List<int>(path);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < bestPath.Count; i++)
        {
            bestPath[i]--;
        }

        Console.WriteLine(string.Join(" ", bestPath));
    }
}

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <algorithm>
#include <random>
#include <iomanip>
#include <thread>
#include <mutex>
#include <atomic>

using namespace std;

const double EPS = 1e-7;

struct Vector3 {
    double x, y, z;
    Vector3() : x(0), y(0), z(0) {}
    Vector3(double _x, double _y, double _z) : x(_x), y(_y), z(_z) {}
    Vector3 operator+(const Vector3& o) const { return {x+o.x, y+o.y, z+o.z}; }
    Vector3 operator-(const Vector3& o) const { return {x-o.x, y-o.y, z-o.z}; }
    Vector3 operator*(double s) const { return {x*s, y*s, z*s}; }
    double dot(const Vector3& o) const { return x*o.x + y*o.y + z*o.z; }
    Vector3 cross(const Vector3& o) const { return {y*o.z - z*o.y, z*o.x - x*o.z, x*o.y - y*o.x}; }
    double length() const { return sqrt(x*x + y*y + z*z); }
    Vector3 normalized() const { double l = length(); return l > 0 ? (*this) * (1.0/l) : *this; }
};

struct AABB {
    Vector3 min_pt, max_pt;
    AABB() { min_pt = {1e30, 1e30, 1e30}; max_pt = {-1e30, -1e30, -1e30}; }
    void expand(const Vector3& p) {
        min_pt.x = min(min_pt.x, p.x); min_pt.y = min(min_pt.y, p.y); min_pt.z = min(min_pt.z, p.z);
        max_pt.x = max(max_pt.x, p.x); max_pt.y = max(max_pt.y, p.y); max_pt.z = max(max_pt.z, p.z);
    }
    void expand(const AABB& o) { expand(o.min_pt); expand(o.max_pt); }
    bool intersects(const AABB& o) const {
        return (min_pt.x <= o.max_pt.x && max_pt.x >= o.min_pt.x &&
                min_pt.y <= o.max_pt.y && max_pt.y >= o.min_pt.y &&
                min_pt.z <= o.max_pt.z && max_pt.z >= o.min_pt.z);
    }
    bool intersectRay(const Vector3& ro, const Vector3& rd, double& t_out) const {
        double tmin = -1e30, tmax = 1e30;
        for (int i=0; i<3; ++i) {
            double invD = 1.0 / (&rd.x)[i];
            double t0 = ((&min_pt.x)[i] - (&ro.x)[i]) * invD;
            double t1 = ((&max_pt.x)[i] - (&ro.x)[i]) * invD;
            if (invD < 0.0) std::swap(t0, t1);
            tmin = t0 > tmin ? t0 : tmin;
            tmax = t1 < tmax ? t1 : tmax;
            if (tmax < tmin) return false;
        }
        if (tmax < 0) return false;
        t_out = max(0.0, tmin);
        return true;
    }
};

struct Triangle {
    Vector3 v[3];
    Vector3 normal;
    double d;
    AABB aabb;
    void compute() {
        normal = (v[1]-v[0]).cross(v[2]-v[0]).normalized();
        d = normal.dot(v[0]);
        aabb = AABB();
        aabb.expand(v[0]); aabb.expand(v[1]); aabb.expand(v[2]);
        aabb.min_pt = aabb.min_pt - Vector3(EPS, EPS, EPS);
        aabb.max_pt = aabb.max_pt + Vector3(EPS, EPS, EPS);
    }
};

struct BVHNode {
    AABB aabb;
    int left, right;
    int first_tri, num_tris;
};

class BVH {
public:
    vector<BVHNode> nodes;
    vector<Triangle> tris;
    
    int build(int start, int count) {
        int idx = nodes.size();
        nodes.push_back(BVHNode());
        AABB box;
        for (int i=0; i<count; ++i) box.expand(tris[start+i].aabb);
        nodes[idx].aabb = box;
        
        if (count <= 4) {
            nodes[idx].left = nodes[idx].right = -1;
            nodes[idx].first_tri = start;
            nodes[idx].num_tris = count;
            return idx;
        }
        
        Vector3 extent = box.max_pt - box.min_pt;
        int axis = 0;
        if (extent.y > extent.x && extent.y > extent.z) axis = 1;
        else if (extent.z > extent.x && extent.z > extent.y) axis = 2;
        
        auto cmp = [axis](const Triangle& a, const Triangle& b) {
            return (&a.aabb.min_pt.x)[axis] + (&a.aabb.max_pt.x)[axis] < 
                   (&b.aabb.min_pt.x)[axis] + (&b.aabb.max_pt.x)[axis];
        };
        std::nth_element(tris.begin() + start, tris.begin() + start + count/2, tris.begin() + start + count, cmp);
        
        int mid = count / 2;
        nodes[idx].left = build(start, mid);
        nodes[idx].right = build(start + mid, count - mid);
        nodes[idx].num_tris = 0;
        return idx;
    }
    
    void findOverlapping(int nodeIdx, const AABB& box, vector<int>& out_indices) const {
        if (!nodes[nodeIdx].aabb.intersects(box)) return;
        if (nodes[nodeIdx].num_tris > 0) {
            for (int i=0; i<nodes[nodeIdx].num_tris; ++i) {
                if (tris[nodes[nodeIdx].first_tri + i].aabb.intersects(box)) {
                    out_indices.push_back(nodes[nodeIdx].first_tri + i);
                }
            }
        } else {
            findOverlapping(nodes[nodeIdx].left, box, out_indices);
            findOverlapping(nodes[nodeIdx].right, box, out_indices);
        }
    }
    
    void findClosest(int nodeIdx, const Vector3& ro, const Vector3& rd, double& min_t, const Triangle*& best_tri, double& best_u, double& best_v) const {
        double t_box;
        if (!nodes[nodeIdx].aabb.intersectRay(ro, rd, t_box)) return;
        if (t_box > min_t) return;
        
        if (nodes[nodeIdx].num_tris > 0) {
            for (int i=0; i<nodes[nodeIdx].num_tris; ++i) {
                const Triangle& tri = tris[nodes[nodeIdx].first_tri + i];
                Vector3 e1 = tri.v[1] - tri.v[0];
                Vector3 e2 = tri.v[2] - tri.v[0];
                Vector3 h = rd.cross(e2);
                double a = e1.dot(h);
                if (std::abs(a) < 1e-12) continue;
                double f = 1.0 / a;
                Vector3 s = ro - tri.v[0];
                double u = f * s.dot(h);
                if (u < 0.0 || u > 1.0) continue;
                Vector3 q = s.cross(e1);
                double v = f * rd.dot(q);
                if (v < 0.0 || u + v > 1.0) continue;
                double t = f * e2.dot(q);
                if (t > 1e-8 && t < min_t) {
                    min_t = t;
                    best_tri = &tri;
                    best_u = u;
                    best_v = v;
                }
            }
        } else {
            double tl = 1e30, tr = 1e30;
            bool hl = nodes[nodes[nodeIdx].left].aabb.intersectRay(ro, rd, tl);
            bool hr = nodes[nodes[nodeIdx].right].aabb.intersectRay(ro, rd, tr);
            int first = nodes[nodeIdx].left, second = nodes[nodeIdx].right;
            if (hl && hr && tr < tl) std::swap(first, second);
            if (hl || hr) {
                findClosest(first, ro, rd, min_t, best_tri, best_u, best_v);
                findClosest(second, ro, rd, min_t, best_tri, best_u, best_v);
            }
        }
    }
    
    bool isInside(const Vector3& p) const {
        if (tris.empty()) return false;
        int attempts = 0;
        thread_local mt19937 rng(1337 + std::hash<std::thread::id>{}(std::this_thread::get_id()));
        uniform_real_distribution<double> dist(-1.0, 1.0);
        while (attempts++ < 50) {
            Vector3 rd(dist(rng), dist(rng), dist(rng));
            if (rd.length() < 0.1) continue;
            rd = rd.normalized();
            
            double min_t = 1e30;
            const Triangle* best_tri = nullptr;
            double best_u = 0, best_v = 0;
            
            findClosest(0, p, rd, min_t, best_tri, best_u, best_v);
            
            if (!best_tri) return false;
            
            if (best_u < 1e-3 || best_v < 1e-3 || (1.0 - best_u - best_v) < 1e-3) {
                if (attempts == 50) return rd.dot(best_tri->normal) > 0;
                continue;
            }
            if (std::abs(rd.dot(best_tri->normal)) < 1e-3) {
                if (attempts == 50) return rd.dot(best_tri->normal) > 0;
                continue;
            }
            
            return rd.dot(best_tri->normal) > 0;
        }
        return false;
    }
};

struct Polygon {
    vector<Vector3> verts;
    Vector3 normal;
    int coplanar_same = 0;
    int coplanar_opp = 0;
};

void split(const Polygon& poly, const Vector3& p_n, double p_d, vector<Polygon>& out) {
    vector<double> dists;
    int front = 0, back = 0, coplanar = 0;
    for (const auto& v : poly.verts) {
        double d = p_n.dot(v) - p_d;
        if (std::abs(d) < EPS) { d = 0; coplanar++; }
        else if (d > 0) front++;
        else back++;
        dists.push_back(d);
    }
    
    if (front == 0 && back == 0) {
        Polygon cp = poly;
        if (poly.normal.dot(p_n) > 0) cp.coplanar_same = 1;
        else cp.coplanar_opp = 1;
        out.push_back(cp);
        return;
    }
    if (front == 0 || back == 0) {
        out.push_back(poly);
        return;
    }
    
    vector<Vector3> f, b;
    int n = poly.verts.size();
    for (int i=0; i<n; ++i) {
        int j = (i + 1) % n;
        double di = dists[i], dj = dists[j];
        Vector3 vi = poly.verts[i], vj = poly.verts[j];
        
        if (di >= 0) f.push_back(vi);
        if (di <= 0) b.push_back(vi);
        
        if ((di > 0 && dj < 0) || (di < 0 && dj > 0)) {
            double t = di / (di - dj);
            Vector3 v = vi + (vj - vi) * t;
            f.push_back(v);
            b.push_back(v);
        }
    }
    
    if (f.size() >= 3) {
        Polygon pf; pf.verts = f; pf.normal = poly.normal; 
        pf.coplanar_same = poly.coplanar_same; pf.coplanar_opp = poly.coplanar_opp;
        out.push_back(pf);
    }
    if (b.size() >= 3) {
        Polygon pb; pb.verts = b; pb.normal = poly.normal;
        pb.coplanar_same = poly.coplanar_same; pb.coplanar_opp = poly.coplanar_opp;
        out.push_back(pb);
    }
}

bool potential_intersect(const Triangle& t1, const Triangle& t2) {
    if (!t1.aabb.intersects(t2.aabb)) return false;
    double d1 = t2.normal.dot(t1.v[0]) - t2.d;
    double d2 = t2.normal.dot(t1.v[1]) - t2.d;
    double d3 = t2.normal.dot(t1.v[2]) - t2.d;
    if ((d1 > EPS && d2 > EPS && d3 > EPS) || 
        (d1 < -EPS && d2 < -EPS && d3 < -EPS)) return false;
        
    double e1 = t1.normal.dot(t2.v[0]) - t1.d;
    double e2 = t1.normal.dot(t2.v[1]) - t1.d;
    double e3 = t1.normal.dot(t2.v[2]) - t1.d;
    if ((e1 > EPS && e2 > EPS && e3 > EPS) || 
        (e1 < -EPS && e2 < -EPS && e3 < -EPS)) return false;
        
    return true;
}

Vector3 computeCentroid(const Polygon& p) {
    Vector3 c(0,0,0);
    for (const auto& v : p.verts) c = c + v;
    return c * (1.0 / p.verts.size());
}

struct Mesh {
    vector<Vector3> verts;
    vector<Triangle> tris;
};

struct Key3D {
    long long x, y, z;
    bool operator==(const Key3D& o) const { return x==o.x && y==o.y && z==o.z; }
};
struct KeyHash {
    size_t operator()(const Key3D& k) const {
        size_t h1 = std::hash<long long>()(k.x);
        size_t h2 = std::hash<long long>()(k.y);
        size_t h3 = std::hash<long long>()(k.z);
        return h1 ^ (h2 << 1) ^ (h3 << 2);
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    
    int VA, FA, VB, FB;
    if (!(cin >> VA >> FA >> VB >> FB)) return 0;
    
    Mesh meshA, meshB;
    meshA.verts.resize(VA);
    for (int i=0; i<VA; ++i) cin >> meshA.verts[i].x >> meshA.verts[i].y >> meshA.verts[i].z;
    meshA.tris.resize(FA);
    for (int i=0; i<FA; ++i) {
        int a, b, c; cin >> a >> b >> c;
        meshA.tris[i].v[0] = meshA.verts[a];
        meshA.tris[i].v[1] = meshA.verts[b];
        meshA.tris[i].v[2] = meshA.verts[c];
    }
    
    meshB.verts.resize(VB);
    for (int i=0; i<VB; ++i) cin >> meshB.verts[i].x >> meshB.verts[i].y >> meshB.verts[i].z;
    meshB.tris.resize(FB);
    for (int i=0; i<FB; ++i) {
        int a, b, c; cin >> a >> b >> c;
        meshB.tris[i].v[0] = meshB.verts[a];
        meshB.tris[i].v[1] = meshB.verts[b];
        meshB.tris[i].v[2] = meshB.verts[c];
    }
    
    Vector3 min_ext = (VA > 0) ? meshA.verts[0] : ((VB > 0) ? meshB.verts[0] : Vector3(0,0,0));
    Vector3 max_ext = min_ext;
    for(auto* m : {&meshA, &meshB}) {
        for(auto& v : m->verts) {
            min_ext.x = min(min_ext.x, v.x); min_ext.y = min(min_ext.y, v.y); min_ext.z = min(min_ext.z, v.z);
            max_ext.x = max(max_ext.x, v.x); max_ext.y = max(max_ext.y, v.y); max_ext.z = max(max_ext.z, v.z);
        }
    }
    Vector3 center = (min_ext + max_ext) * 0.5;
    Vector3 extent = max_ext - min_ext;
    double max_dim = max({extent.x, extent.y, extent.z});
    if (max_dim < 1e-12) max_dim = 1.0;
    double scale = 1.0 / max_dim;
    
    for(auto* m : {&meshA, &meshB}) {
        for(auto& t : m->tris) {
            for(int i=0; i<3; ++i) t.v[i] = (t.v[i] - center) * scale;
            t.compute();
        }
    }
    
    BVH bvhA, bvhB;
    bvhA.tris = meshA.tris;
    if (FA > 0) bvhA.build(0, FA);
    bvhB.tris = meshB.tris;
    if (FB > 0) bvhB.build(0, FB);
    
    int num_threads = thread::hardware_concurrency();
    if (num_threads == 0) num_threads = 8;
    
    vector<Polygon> all_polys;
    mutex out_mtx;
    
    auto workerA = [&](int start, int end) {
        vector<Polygon> local_p;
        for (int i=start; i<end; ++i) {
            const Triangle& tri = meshA.tris[i];
            vector<int> b_idx;
            if (FB > 0) bvhB.findOverlapping(0, tri.aabb, b_idx);
            vector<int> exact_b;
            for (int idx : b_idx) {
                if (potential_intersect(tri, bvhB.tris[idx])) exact_b.push_back(idx);
            }
            
            vector<Polygon> polys = { { {tri.v[0], tri.v[1], tri.v[2]}, tri.normal, 0, 0 } };
            for (int idx : exact_b) {
                const Triangle& tb = bvhB.tris[idx];
                vector<Polygon> next;
                for (const auto& p : polys) split(p, tb.normal, tb.d, next);
                polys = next;
            }
            
            for (const auto& p : polys) {
                if (p.coplanar_opp) continue;
                Vector3 c = computeCentroid(p);
                bool is_same = p.coplanar_same > 0;
                Vector3 test_p = is_same ? c + p.normal * 1e-5 : c;
                if (!bvhB.isInside(test_p)) {
                    local_p.push_back(p);
                }
            }
        }
        lock_guard<mutex> lk(out_mtx);
        all_polys.insert(all_polys.end(), local_p.begin(), local_p.end());
    };
    
    auto workerB = [&](int start, int end) {
        vector<Polygon> local_p;
        for (int i=start; i<end; ++i) {
            const Triangle& tri = meshB.tris[i];
            vector<int> a_idx;
            if (FA > 0) bvhA.findOverlapping(0, tri.aabb, a_idx);
            vector<int> exact_a;
            for (int idx : a_idx) {
                if (potential_intersect(tri, bvhA.tris[idx])) exact_a.push_back(idx);
            }
            
            vector<Polygon> polys = { { {tri.v[0], tri.v[1], tri.v[2]}, tri.normal, 0, 0 } };
            for (int idx : exact_a) {
                const Triangle& ta = bvhA.tris[idx];
                vector<Polygon> next;
                for (const auto& p : polys) split(p, ta.normal, ta.d, next);
                polys = next;
            }
            
            for (const auto& p : polys) {
                if (p.coplanar_opp) continue;
                if (p.coplanar_same) continue; 
                Vector3 c = computeCentroid(p);
                if (!bvhA.isInside(c)) {
                    local_p.push_back(p);
                }
            }
        }
        lock_guard<mutex> lk(out_mtx);
        all_polys.insert(all_polys.end(), local_p.begin(), local_p.end());
    };
    
    vector<thread> threads;
    int chunkA = (FA + num_threads - 1) / num_threads;
    for (int i=0; i<num_threads; ++i) {
        int s = i * chunkA;
        int e = min(FA, s + chunkA);
        if (s < e) threads.push_back(thread(workerA, s, e));
    }
    for (auto& t : threads) t.join();
    threads.clear();
    
    int chunkB = (FB + num_threads - 1) / num_threads;
    for (int i=0; i<num_threads; ++i) {
        int s = i * chunkB;
        int e = min(FB, s + chunkB);
        if (s < e) threads.push_back(thread(workerB, s, e));
    }
    for (auto& t : threads) t.join();
    
    double inv_scale = max_dim;
    vector<Vector3> out_verts;
    vector<vector<int>> out_faces;
    unordered_map<Key3D, int, KeyHash> vmap;
    
    for (const auto& p : all_polys) {
        if (p.verts.size() < 3) continue;
        vector<int> idxs;
        for (const auto& v : p.verts) {
            Key3D k = { (long long)std::round(v.x * 1e6), (long long)std::round(v.y * 1e6), (long long)std::round(v.z * 1e6) };
            auto it = vmap.find(k);
            int idx;
            if (it != vmap.end()) idx = it->second;
            else {
                idx = out_verts.size();
                out_verts.push_back(v * inv_scale + center);
                vmap[k] = idx;
            }
            if (idxs.empty() || idxs.back() != idx) idxs.push_back(idx);
        }
        if (idxs.size() > 1 && idxs.back() == idxs.front()) idxs.pop_back();
        
        if (idxs.size() >= 3) {
            int i0 = idxs[0];
            for (size_t i = 1; i < idxs.size() - 1; ++i) {
                out_faces.push_back({i0, idxs[i], idxs[i+1]});
            }
        }
    }
    
    cout << out_verts.size() << " " << out_faces.size() << "\n";
    cout << fixed << setprecision(6);
    for (const auto& v : out_verts) {
        cout << v.x << " " << v.y << " " << v.z << "\n";
    }
    for (const auto& f : out_faces) {
        cout << f[0] << " " << f[1] << " " << f[2] << "\n";
    }
    
    return 0;
}

use std::io::{self, BufRead, Read, Write};
use std::collections::VecDeque;

struct FastOut<W: Write> {
    writer: W,
    buf: Vec<u8>,
}

impl<W: Write> FastOut<W> {
    fn new(writer: W) -> Self {
        Self {
            writer,
            buf: Vec::with_capacity(128 * 1024),
        }
    }

    fn write_u32(&mut self, mut n: u32) {
        if n == 0 {
            self.push(b'0');
            return;
        }
        let mut temp = [0u8; 10];
        let mut idx = 10;
        while n > 0 {
            idx -= 1;
            temp[idx] = b'0' + (n % 10) as u8;
            n /= 10;
        }
        let slice = &temp[idx..];
        if self.buf.len() + slice.len() > self.buf.capacity() {
            self.writer.write_all(&self.buf).unwrap();
            self.buf.clear();
        }
        self.buf.extend_from_slice(slice);
    }

    fn push(&mut self, b: u8) {
        if self.buf.len() == self.buf.capacity() {
            self.writer.write_all(&self.buf).unwrap();
            self.buf.clear();
        }
        self.buf.push(b);
    }

    fn flush(&mut self) {
        if !self.buf.is_empty() {
            self.writer.write_all(&self.buf).unwrap();
            self.buf.clear();
        }
    }
}

fn main() {
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let mut handle = stdin.lock();

    let mut header = String::new();
    handle.read_line(&mut header).unwrap();
    let parts: Vec<usize> = header.trim().split_whitespace().map(|s| s.parse().unwrap()).collect();
    if parts.len() < 2 { return; }
    let h = parts[0];
    let w = parts[1];

    let total_cells = h * w;
    let mut grid = Vec::with_capacity(total_cells);
    let mut start_idx = u32::MAX;
    let mut end_idx = u32::MAX;

    // Use a heap-allocated buffer to prevent stack overflow on Windows (MSVC default stack size is 1MB)
    let mut buffer = vec![0u8; 1024 * 1024];
    while let Ok(n) = handle.read(&mut buffer) {
        if n == 0 { break; }
        for i in 0..n {
            let b = buffer[i];
            if b != b'\n' && b != b'\r' {
                if b == b'A' {
                    start_idx = grid.len() as u32;
                } else if b == b'B' {
                    end_idx = grid.len() as u32;
                }
                grid.push(b);
                if grid.len() == total_cells {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if grid.len() == total_cells {
            break;
        }
    }

    if start_idx == u32::MAX || end_idx == u32::MAX {
        println!("0");
        return;
    }
    if start_idx == end_idx {
        println!("1");
        println!("{} {}", start_idx % (w as u32), start_idx / (w as u32));
        return;
    }

    let w32 = w as u32;
    let h32 = h as u32;

    let mut queue = VecDeque::new();
    queue.push_back(start_idx);

    let mut found = false;
    let mut before_end = u32::MAX;

    // BFS loop using grid for storing parent directions to save massive amounts of memory
    while let Some(curr) = queue.pop_front() {
        let r = curr / w32;
        let c = curr % w32;

        // Up
        if r > 0 {
            let next = curr - w32;
            let b = unsafe { *grid.get_unchecked(next as usize) };
            if b == b'B' {
                found = true;
                before_end = curr;
                break;
            } else if b == b' ' {
                unsafe { *grid.get_unchecked_mut(next as usize) = b'D' };
                queue.push_back(next);
            }
        }
        // Down
        if r + 1 < h32 {
            let next = curr + w32;
            let b = unsafe { *grid.get_unchecked(next as usize) };
            if b == b'B' {
                found = true;
                before_end = curr;
                break;
            } else if b == b' ' {
                unsafe { *grid.get_unchecked_mut(next as usize) = b'U' };
                queue.push_back(next);
            }
        }
        // Left
        if c > 0 {
            let next = curr - 1;
            let b = unsafe { *grid.get_unchecked(next as usize) };
            if b == b'B' {
                found = true;
                before_end = curr;
                break;
            } else if b == b' ' {
                unsafe { *grid.get_unchecked_mut(next as usize) = b'R' };
                queue.push_back(next);
            }
        }
        // Right
        if c + 1 < w32 {
            let next = curr + 1;
            let b = unsafe { *grid.get_unchecked(next as usize) };
            if b == b'B' {
                found = true;
                before_end = curr;
                break;
            } else if b == b' ' {
                unsafe { *grid.get_unchecked_mut(next as usize) = b'L' };
                queue.push_back(next);
            }
        }
    }

    let stdout = io::stdout();
    let mut out = FastOut::new(stdout.lock());

    if found {
        let mut path = Vec::new();
        path.push(end_idx);
        let mut current = before_end;
        while current != start_idx {
            path.push(current);
            let back_dir = unsafe { *grid.get_unchecked(current as usize) };
            if back_dir == b'U' {
                current -= w32;
            } else if back_dir == b'D' {
                current += w32;
            } else if back_dir == b'L' {
                current -= 1;
            } else if back_dir == b'R' {
                current += 1;
            } else {
                panic!("Broken path");
            }
        }
        path.push(start_idx);

        out.write_u32(path.len() as u32);
        out.push(b'\n');
        // Reconstruct path in correct order natively
        for &node in path.iter().rev() {
            out.write_u32(node % w32); // x
            out.push(b' ');
            out.write_u32(node / w32); // y
            out.push(b'\n');
        }
    } else {
        out.write_u32(0);
        out.push(b'\n');
    }
    out.flush();
}
