using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Text;

class Program
{
    static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        // Use extremely fast custom I/O for millions of elements
        using var stream = new BufferedStream(Console.OpenStandardInput(), 1024 * 1024);
        var reader = new CustomReader(stream);

        int N = reader.ReadInt();
        if (N <= 0)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(0);
            return;
        }
        int stockLength = reader.ReadInt();

        Cut[] cuts = new Cut[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        {
            cuts[i] = new Cut { Size = reader.ReadInt(), OriginalIndex = i };
        }

        // FFD (First-Fit Decreasing) Heuristic: O(N log N)
        Array.Sort(cuts);

        // Segment tree to maintain the maximum remaining space in each bin subtree.
        // This allows us to find the first bin that can accommodate a cut in O(log N) time.
        // Maximum number of bins is N. Tree size 4*N is safely bounded.
        int[] maxSpace = new int[4 * N];
        Array.Fill(maxSpace, stockLength);

        // Linked list to store original indices of cuts for each bin efficiently.
        // This avoids allocating List<int> objects and reduces GC pressure to zero.
        int[] binHead = new int[N];
        Array.Fill(binHead, -1);
        int[] nextItem = new int[N];

        int numBins = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        {
            int binIndex = QueryAndUpdate(maxSpace, 1, 0, N - 1, cuts[i].Size);
            if (binIndex >= numBins)
            {
                numBins = binIndex + 1;
            }
            
            // Prepend cut index to the bin's linked list
            int cutOriginalIndex = cuts[i].OriginalIndex;
            nextItem[cutOriginalIndex] = binHead[binIndex];
            binHead[binIndex] = cutOriginalIndex;
        }

        // Fast output
        using var outStream = new BufferedStream(Console.OpenStandardOutput(), 1024 * 1024);
        using var writer = new StreamWriter(outStream, new UTF8Encoding(false), 1024 * 1024);
        
        writer.WriteLine(numBins);
        for (int i = 0; i < numBins; i++)
        {
            int curr = binHead[i];
            bool first = true;
            while (curr != -1)
            {
                if (!first) writer.Write(' ');
                writer.Write(curr);
                first = false;
                curr = nextItem[curr];
            }
            writer.WriteLine();
        }
    }

    struct Cut : IComparable<Cut>
    {
        public int Size;
        public int OriginalIndex;

        public int CompareTo(Cut other)
        {
            int cmp = other.Size.CompareTo(this.Size); // Descending order
            // Tie breaker for stable sorting
            if (cmp == 0) return this.OriginalIndex.CompareTo(other.OriginalIndex);
            return cmp;
        }
    }

    // Finds the smallest bin index that can accommodate 'val' space and updates the tree
    static int QueryAndUpdate(int[] tree, int node, int l, int r, int val)
    {
        if (l == r)
        {
            tree[node] -= val;
            return l;
        }
        int mid = l + (r - l) / 2;
        int res;
        
        // If left child has enough space, go left to maintain "First-Fit" property
        if (tree[2 * node] >= val)
        {
            res = QueryAndUpdate(tree, 2 * node, l, mid, val);
        }
        else
        {
            res = QueryAndUpdate(tree, 2 * node + 1, mid + 1, r, val);
        }
        
        // Update current node max space
        tree[node] = Math.Max(tree[2 * node], tree[2 * node + 1]);
        return res;
    }

    class CustomReader
    {
        private Stream stream;
        private byte[] buffer = new byte[1024 * 1024];
        private int head = 0;
        private int tail = 0;

        public CustomReader(Stream stream)
        {
            this.stream = stream;
        }

        [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
        public int ReadInt()
        {
            int c = Read();
            while (c != -1 && c <= 32)
            {
                c = Read();
            }
            if (c == -1) return -1;

            int res = 0;
            while (c > 32)
            {
                res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
                c = Read();
            }
            return res;
        }

        [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
        private int Read()
        {
            if (head >= tail)
            {
                head = 0;
                tail = stream.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);
                if (tail == 0) return -1;
            }
            return buffer[head++];
        }
    }
}

Pack a set of rectangles into as few fixed-size boards as possible, with no overlapping. Rectangles may be rotated 90° to fit better. Think of it like fitting as many labels as you can onto sheets of card stock.

This 2D packing problem is NP-hard. Subpasses increase the number and variety of rectangles. The baseline stacks rectangles in simple horizontal rows.

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>

using namespace std;

struct RectInfo {
    int id;
    int w, h;
    int max_dim;
    int min_dim;
    long long area;
    
    int board_idx;
    int x, y;
    int rotated;
};

struct FreeRect {
    int x, y, w, h;
};

struct Placement {
    int board_idx;
    int x, y;
    int rotated;
};

struct Solution {
    int num_boards;
    vector<Placement> placements;
};

class Board {
public:
    int id;
    int W, H;
    vector<FreeRect> free_rects;
    int max_w_free;
    int max_h_free;
    long long max_area_free;

    Board(int id, int W, int H) : id(id), W(W), H(H) {
        free_rects.push_back({0, 0, W, H});
        max_w_free = max(W, H);
        max_h_free = min(W, H);
        max_area_free = (long long)W * H;
    }

    bool can_fit(int item_w, int item_h) const {
        if (max_area_free < (long long)item_w * item_h) return false;
        int i_max = max(item_w, item_h);
        int i_min = min(item_w, item_h);
        return i_max <= max_w_free && i_min <= max_h_free;
    }

    void update_max_dims() {
        max_w_free = 0;
        max_h_free = 0;
        max_area_free = 0;
        for (const auto& fr : free_rects) {
            max_w_free = max(max_w_free, max(fr.w, fr.h));
            max_h_free = max(max_h_free, min(fr.w, fr.h));
            max_area_free = max(max_area_free, (long long)fr.w * fr.h);
        }
    }

    void merge_free_rects() {
        bool merged = true;
        while (merged) {
            merged = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)free_rects.size(); ++i) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j < (int)free_rects.size(); ++j) {
                    if (free_rects[i].w == free_rects[j].w && free_rects[i].x == free_rects[j].x) {
                        if (free_rects[i].y + free_rects[i].h == free_rects[j].y) {
                            free_rects[i].h += free_rects[j].h;
                            free_rects.erase(free_rects.begin() + j);
                            merged = true; break;
                        }
                        if (free_rects[j].y + free_rects[j].h == free_rects[i].y) {
                            free_rects[i].y = free_rects[j].y;
                            free_rects[i].h += free_rects[j].h;
                            free_rects.erase(free_rects.begin() + j);
                            merged = true; break;
                        }
                    }
                    else if (free_rects[i].h == free_rects[j].h && free_rects[i].y == free_rects[j].y) {
                        if (free_rects[i].x + free_rects[i].w == free_rects[j].x) {
                            free_rects[i].w += free_rects[j].w;
                            free_rects.erase(free_rects.begin() + j);
                            merged = true; break;
                        }
                        if (free_rects[j].x + free_rects[j].w == free_rects[i].x) {
                            free_rects[i].x = free_rects[j].x;
                            free_rects[i].w += free_rects[j].w;
                            free_rects.erase(free_rects.begin() + j);
                            merged = true; break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (merged) break;
            }
        }
    }

    bool try_pack(int item_w, int item_h, int& out_x, int& out_y, int& out_rot, 
                  long long min_item_area, int min_item_max_dim, int min_item_min_dim, 
                  int fit_strategy, int split_strategy) {
        int best_i = -1;
        long long best_score1 = 3e18;
        long long best_score2 = 3e18;
        int best_rot = 0;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)free_rects.size(); ++i) {
            const auto& fr = free_rects[i];
            
            for (int rot = 0; rot <= 1; ++rot) {
                int w = rot ? item_h : item_w;
                int h = rot ? item_w : item_h;
                
                if (w <= fr.w && h <= fr.h) {
                    long long score1, score2;
                    if (fit_strategy == 0) { // BSSF
                        score1 = min(fr.w - w, fr.h - h);
                        score2 = max(fr.w - w, fr.h - h);
                    } else { // BAF
                        score1 = (long long)fr.w * fr.h - (long long)w * h;
                        score2 = min(fr.w - w, fr.h - h);
                    }
                    
                    if (score1 < best_score1 || (score1 == best_score1 && score2 < best_score2)) {
                        best_score1 = score1;
                        best_score2 = score2;
                        best_i = i;
                        best_rot = rot;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (best_i == -1) return false;
        
        FreeRect best_fr = free_rects[best_i];
        out_x = best_fr.x;
        out_y = best_fr.y;
        out_rot = best_rot;
        
        int w = best_rot ? item_h : item_w;
        int h = best_rot ? item_w : item_h;
        
        free_rects.erase(free_rects.begin() + best_i);
        
        long long s1_f1_area = (long long)(best_fr.w - w) * h;
        long long s1_f2_area = (long long)best_fr.w * (best_fr.h - h);
        
        long long s2_f1_area = (long long)(best_fr.w - w) * best_fr.h;
        long long s2_f2_area = (long long)w * (best_fr.h - h);
        
        FreeRect new1, new2;
        bool split_horizontal;
        
        if (split_strategy == 0) { // MAXAS
            long long s1_max = max(s1_f1_area, s1_f2_area);
            long long s2_max = max(s2_f1_area, s2_f2_area);
            split_horizontal = (s1_max > s2_max);
        } else { // MINAS
            long long s1_min = min(s1_f1_area, s1_f2_area);
            long long s2_min = min(s2_f1_area, s2_f2_area);
            split_horizontal = (s1_min < s2_min);
        }
        
        if (split_horizontal) {
            new1 = {best_fr.x + w, best_fr.y, best_fr.w - w, h};
            new2 = {best_fr.x, best_fr.y + h, best_fr.w, best_fr.h - h};
        } else {
            new1 = {best_fr.x + w, best_fr.y, best_fr.w - w, best_fr.h};
            new2 = {best_fr.x, best_fr.y + h, w, best_fr.h - h};
        }
        
        auto add_if_valid = [&](const FreeRect& fr) {
            if (fr.w > 0 && fr.h > 0) {
                long long area = (long long)fr.w * fr.h;
                if (area >= min_item_area && max(fr.w, fr.h) >= min_item_max_dim && min(fr.w, fr.h) >= min_item_min_dim) {
                    free_rects.push_back(fr);
                }
            }
        };
        
        add_if_valid(new1);
        add_if_valid(new2);
        
        merge_free_rects();
        update_max_dims();
        return true;
    }
};

Solution solve(const vector<RectInfo>& original_items, int board_width, int board_height, 
               long long min_area, int min_max_dim, int min_min_dim, 
               int sort_strategy, int fit_strategy, int split_strategy) {
    vector<RectInfo> items = original_items;
    
    if (sort_strategy == 0) {
        sort(items.begin(), items.end(), [](const RectInfo& a, const RectInfo& b) {
            if (a.max_dim != b.max_dim) return a.max_dim > b.max_dim;
            if (a.min_dim != b.min_dim) return a.min_dim > b.min_dim;
            return a.id < b.id;
        });
    } else if (sort_strategy == 1) {
        sort(items.begin(), items.end(), [](const RectInfo& a, const RectInfo& b) {
            if (a.area != b.area) return a.area > b.area;
            if (a.max_dim != b.max_dim) return a.max_dim > b.max_dim;
            return a.id < b.id;
        });
    } else if (sort_strategy == 2) {
        sort(items.begin(), items.end(), [](const RectInfo& a, const RectInfo& b) {
            long long p1 = (long long)a.w + a.h;
            long long p2 = (long long)b.w + b.h;
            if (p1 != p2) return p1 > p2;
            if (a.max_dim != b.max_dim) return a.max_dim > b.max_dim;
            return a.id < b.id;
        });
    } else if (sort_strategy == 3) {
        sort(items.begin(), items.end(), [](const RectInfo& a, const RectInfo& b) {
            if (a.min_dim != b.min_dim) return a.min_dim > b.min_dim;
            if (a.max_dim != b.max_dim) return a.max_dim > b.max_dim;
            return a.id < b.id;
        });
    }
    
    vector<Board> boards;
    boards.reserve(items.size());
    vector<int> active_boards;
    active_boards.reserve(items.size());

    for (int i = 0; i < (int)items.size(); ++i) {
        RectInfo& item = items[i];
        bool placed = false;
        
        for (int b_idx : active_boards) {
            if (boards[b_idx].can_fit(item.w, item.h)) {
                if (boards[b_idx].try_pack(item.w, item.h, item.x, item.y, item.rotated, 
                                           min_area, min_max_dim, min_min_dim, 
                                           fit_strategy, split_strategy)) {
                    item.board_idx = b_idx;
                    placed = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (!placed) {
            boards.emplace_back(boards.size(), board_width, board_height);
            active_boards.push_back(boards.size() - 1);
            
            boards.back().try_pack(item.w, item.h, item.x, item.y, item.rotated, 
                                   min_area, min_max_dim, min_min_dim, 
                                   fit_strategy, split_strategy);
            item.board_idx = boards.size() - 1;
        }
    }
    
    Solution sol;
    sol.num_boards = boards.size();
    sol.placements.resize(items.size());
    for (const auto& it : items) {
        sol.placements[it.id] = {it.board_idx, it.x, it.y, it.rotated};
    }
    return sol;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int N, board_width, board_height;
    if (!(cin >> N >> board_width >> board_height)) return 0;

    vector<RectInfo> items(N);
    long long min_item_area = 2e18;
    int min_item_max_dim = 2e9;
    int min_item_min_dim = 2e9;

    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        items[i].id = i;
        cin >> items[i].w >> items[i].h;
        items[i].max_dim = max(items[i].w, items[i].h);
        items[i].min_dim = min(items[i].w, items[i].h);
        items[i].area = (long long)items[i].w * items[i].h;
        
        min_item_area = min(min_item_area, items[i].area);
        min_item_max_dim = min(min_item_max_dim, items[i].max_dim);
        min_item_min_dim = min(min_item_min_dim, items[i].min_dim);
    }

    auto start_time = chrono::steady_clock::now();
    Solution best_sol;
    best_sol.num_boards = 2e9;

    for (int sort_strat = 0; sort_strat < 4; ++sort_strat) {
        for (int fit_strat = 0; fit_strat < 2; ++fit_strat) {
            for (int split_strat = 0; split_strat < 2; ++split_strat) {
                auto now = chrono::steady_clock::now();
                double elapsed = chrono::duration<double>(now - start_time).count();
                if (elapsed > 25.0) goto end_search;
                
                Solution sol = solve(items, board_width, board_height, 
                                     min_item_area, min_item_max_dim, min_item_min_dim, 
                                     sort_strat, fit_strat, split_strat);
                if (sol.num_boards < best_sol.num_boards) {
                    best_sol = sol;
                }
            }
        }
    }
end_search:

    cout << best_sol.num_boards << "\n";
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        const auto& p = best_sol.placements[i];
        cout << p.board_idx << " " << p.x << " " << p.y << " " << p.rotated << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}

use std::io::{self, BufRead};
use std::time::Instant;

struct Rng {
    state: u64,
}

impl Rng {
    fn new(seed: u64) -> Self {
        Rng { state: seed }
    }
    fn next_f64(&mut self) -> f64 {
        self.state ^= self.state << 13;
        self.state ^= self.state >> 7;
        self.state ^= self.state << 17;
        let res = self.state.wrapping_mul(0x2545F4914F6CDD1D);
        (res >> 11) as f64 / (1u64 << 53) as f64
    }
}

struct PlacedPiece {
    polygon: Vec<(f64, f64)>,
    bbox: (f64, f64, f64, f64),
}

struct Stock {
    placed: Vec<PlacedPiece>,
    used_area: f64,
}

fn cross_product(p0: (f64, f64), p1: (f64, f64), p2: (f64, f64)) -> f64 {
    (p1.0 - p0.0) * (p2.1 - p0.1) - (p1.1 - p0.1) * (p2.0 - p0.0)
}

fn segments_intersect(p1: (f64, f64), p2: (f64, f64), p3: (f64, f64), p4: (f64, f64)) -> bool {
    let cp1 = cross_product(p3, p4, p1);
    let cp2 = cross_product(p3, p4, p2);
    let cp3 = cross_product(p1, p2, p3);
    let cp4 = cross_product(p1, p2, p4);

    let eps = 1e-7;

    if ((cp1 > eps && cp2 < -eps) || (cp1 < -eps && cp2 > eps)) &&
       ((cp3 > eps && cp4 < -eps) || (cp3 < -eps && cp4 > eps)) {
        return true;
    }
    false
}

fn point_in_or_on_polygon(p: (f64, f64), poly: &[(f64, f64)]) -> bool {
    let mut inside = false;
    let mut j = poly.len() - 1;
    let eps = 1e-7;

    for i in 0..poly.len() {
        let pi = poly[i];
        let pj = poly[j];

        let min_x = pi.0.min(pj.0);
        let max_x = pi.0.max(pj.0);
        let min_y = pi.1.min(pj.1);
        let max_y = pi.1.max(pj.1);
        
        if p.0 >= min_x - eps && p.0 <= max_x + eps && p.1 >= min_y - eps && p.1 <= max_y + eps {
            let cp = (p.0 - pi.0) * (pj.1 - pi.1) - (p.1 - pi.1) * (pj.0 - pi.0);
            if cp.abs() < eps {
                return true;
            }
        }

        if (pi.1 > p.1) != (pj.1 > p.1) {
            let xinters = (pj.0 - pi.0) * (p.1 - pi.1) / (pj.1 - pi.1) + pi.0;
            if p.0 < xinters {
                inside = !inside;
            }
        }
        j = i;
    }
    inside
}

fn point_strictly_inside_polygon(p: (f64, f64), poly: &[(f64, f64)]) -> bool {
    let mut inside = false;
    let mut j = poly.len() - 1;
    let eps = 1e-7;

    for i in 0..poly.len() {
        let pi = poly[i];
        let pj = poly[j];

        let min_x = pi.0.min(pj.0);
        let max_x = pi.0.max(pj.0);
        let min_y = pi.1.min(pj.1);
        let max_y = pi.1.max(pj.1);
        
        if p.0 >= min_x - eps && p.0 <= max_x + eps && p.1 >= min_y - eps && p.1 <= max_y + eps {
            let cp = (p.0 - pi.0) * (pj.1 - pi.1) - (p.1 - pi.1) * (pj.0 - pi.0);
            if cp.abs() < eps {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if (pi.1 > p.1) != (pj.1 > p.1) {
            let xinters = (pj.0 - pi.0) * (p.1 - pi.1) / (pj.1 - pi.1) + pi.0;
            if p.0 < xinters {
                inside = !inside;
            }
        }
        j = i;
    }
    inside
}

fn any_point_strictly_inside(poly1: &[(f64, f64)], poly2: &[(f64, f64)]) -> bool {
    for p in poly1 {
        if point_strictly_inside_polygon(*p, poly2) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    false
}

fn polygons_overlap_fast(poly1: &[(f64, f64)], bb1: (f64, f64, f64, f64), placed: &PlacedPiece) -> bool {
    let bb2 = placed.bbox;
    let eps = 1e-7;
    if bb1.0 > bb2.1 - eps || bb1.1 < bb2.0 + eps || bb1.2 > bb2.3 - eps || bb1.3 < bb2.2 + eps {
        return false;
    }

    let poly2 = &placed.polygon;
    for i in 0..poly1.len() {
        let p1 = poly1[i];
        let p2 = poly1[(i + 1) % poly1.len()];
        for j in 0..poly2.len() {
            let p3 = poly2[j];
            let p4 = poly2[(j + 1) % poly2.len()];
            if segments_intersect(p1, p2, p3, p4) {
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    
    if any_point_strictly_inside(poly1, poly2) {
        return true;
    }
    if any_point_strictly_inside(poly2, poly1) {
        return true;
    }
    
    false
}

fn polygon_inside(inner: &[(f64, f64)], outer: &[(f64, f64)]) -> bool {
    let bbi = bounding_box(inner);
    let bbo = bounding_box(outer);
    let eps = 1e-7;
    if bbi.0 < bbo.0 - eps || bbi.1 > bbo.1 + eps || bbi.2 < bbo.2 - eps || bbi.3 > bbo.3 + eps {
        return false;
    }

    for p in inner {
        if !point_in_or_on_polygon(*p, outer) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    for i in 0..inner.len() {
        let p1 = inner[i];
        let p2 = inner[(i + 1) % inner.len()];
        for j in 0..outer.len() {
            let p3 = outer[j];
            let p4 = outer[(j + 1) % outer.len()];
            if segments_intersect(p1, p2, p3, p4) {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    true
}

fn bounding_box(poly: &[(f64, f64)]) -> (f64, f64, f64, f64) {
    let mut min_x = f64::MAX;
    let mut max_x = f64::MIN;
    let mut min_y = f64::MAX;
    let mut max_y = f64::MIN;
    for &(x, y) in poly {
        if x < min_x { min_x = x; }
        if x > max_x { max_x = x; }
        if y < min_y { min_y = y; }
        if y > max_y { max_y = y; }
    }
    (min_x, max_x, min_y, max_y)
}

fn polygon_area(poly: &[(f64, f64)]) -> f64 {
    let mut area = 0.0;
    for i in 0..poly.len() {
        let p1 = poly[i];
        let p2 = poly[(i + 1) % poly.len()];
        area += p1.0 * p2.1 - p2.0 * p1.1;
    }
    (area / 2.0).abs()
}

fn is_axis_aligned_rectangle(poly: &[(f64, f64)]) -> bool {
    if poly.len() != 4 {
        return false;
    }
    let mut xs = vec![poly[0].0, poly[1].0, poly[2].0, poly[3].0];
    let mut ys = vec![poly[0].1, poly[1].1, poly[2].1, poly[3].1];
    xs.sort_by(|a, b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap());
    ys.sort_by(|a, b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap());
    
    (xs[0] - xs[1]).abs() < 1e-7 && (xs[2] - xs[3]).abs() < 1e-7 &&
    (ys[0] - ys[1]).abs() < 1e-7 && (ys[2] - ys[3]).abs() < 1e-7
}

fn rotate_polygon(poly: &[(f64, f64)], rot: f64) -> Vec<(f64, f64)> {
    let cos_r = rot.cos();
    let sin_r = rot.sin();
    poly.iter().map(|&(x, y)| {
        (x * cos_r - y * sin_r, x * sin_r + y * cos_r)
    }).collect()
}

fn translate_polygon(poly: &[(f64, f64)], dx: f64, dy: f64) -> Vec<(f64, f64)> {
    poly.iter().map(|&(x, y)| (x + dx, y + dy)).collect()
}

fn try_place(
    piece: &[(f64, f64)], 
    stock_poly: &[(f64, f64)], 
    placed: &[PlacedPiece], 
    grid_res: usize, 
    rotations: &[f64],
    stock_is_rect: bool
) -> Option<(f64, f64, f64, Vec<(f64, f64)>)> {
    let (s_min_x, s_max_x, s_min_y, s_max_y) = bounding_box(stock_poly);
    
    let mut candidates = Vec::new();
    let mut rotated_polys = Vec::new();
    
    for (rot_idx, &rot) in rotations.iter().enumerate() {
        let rotated = rotate_polygon(piece, rot);
        let (p_min_x, p_max_x, p_min_y, p_max_y) = bounding_box(&rotated);
        
        rotated_polys.push(rotated);
        
        let dx_min = s_min_x - p_min_x;
        let dx_max = s_max_x - p_max_x;
        let dy_min = s_min_y - p_min_y;
        let dy_max = s_max_y - p_max_y;
        
        if dx_min > dx_max + 1e-7 || dy_min > dy_max + 1e-7 {
            continue;
        }
        
        let dx_max = dx_max.max(dx_min);
        let dy_max = dy_max.max(dy_min);
        
        for i in 0..=grid_res {
            let dx = if grid_res == 0 { dx_min } else { dx_min + (dx_max - dx_min) * (i as f64 / grid_res as f64) };
            for j in 0..=grid_res {
                let dy = if grid_res == 0 { dy_min } else { dy_min + (dy_max - dy_min) * (j as f64 / grid_res as f64) };
                candidates.push((dx, dy, rot_idx));
            }
        }
    }
    
    candidates.sort_by(|a, b| {
        a.1.partial_cmp(&b.1).unwrap().then(a.0.partial_cmp(&b.0).unwrap())
    });
    
    for (dx, dy, rot_idx) in candidates {
        let rot = rotations[rot_idx];
        let rotated = &rotated_polys[rot_idx];
        
        let mut inside_stock = true;
        let mut translated = Vec::new();
        
        if !stock_is_rect {
            translated = translate_polygon(rotated, dx, dy);
            inside_stock = polygon_inside(&translated, stock_poly);
        }
        
        if inside_stock {
            if translated.is_empty() {
                translated = translate_polygon(rotated, dx, dy);
            }
            let bb_trans = bounding_box(&translated);
            let mut overlap = false;
            for pl in placed {
                if polygons_overlap_fast(&translated, bb_trans, pl) {
                    overlap = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if !overlap {
                return Some((dx, dy, rot, translated));
            }
        }
    }
    None
}

fn place_in_existing_stocks(
    piece: &[(f64, f64)],
    piece_area: f64,
    stock_area: f64,
    stock_poly: &[(f64, f64)],
    stocks: &mut [Stock],
    stock_is_rect: bool
) -> Option<(usize, f64, f64, f64, Vec<(f64, f64)>)> {
    let rotations = [0.0, std::f64::consts::PI / 2.0, std::f64::consts::PI, 3.0 * std::f64::consts::PI / 2.0];
    
    let res = if stocks.len() < 5 {
        60
    } else if stocks.len() < 20 {
        40
    } else if stocks.len() < 100 {
        20
    } else if stocks.len() < 500 {
        10

}

fn place_in_new_stock(

    let (s_min_x, s_max_x, s_min_y, s_max_y) = bounding_box(stock_poly);

        let dx_min = s_min_x - p_min_x;
        let dx_max = s_max_x - p_max_x;
        let dy_min = s_min_y - p_min_y;
        let dy_max = s_max_y - p_max_y;
        if dx_min > dx_max || dy_min > dy_max { continue; }
        
        let dx = dx_min + rng.next_f64() * (dx_max - dx_min);
        let dy = dy_min + rng.next_f64() * (dy_max - dy_min);

            }
            return Some((dx, dy, rot, translated));
        }
    }
    
    Some((0.0, 0.0, 0.0, piece.to_vec()))
}

use std::io::{self, BufRead};
use std::time::Instant;

struct Rng {
    state: u64,
}

impl Rng {
    fn new(seed: u64) -> Self {
        Rng { state: seed }
    }
    fn next_f64(&mut self) -> f64 {
        self.state ^= self.state << 13;
        self.state ^= self.state >> 7;
        self.state ^= self.state << 17;
        let res = self.state.wrapping_mul(0x2545F4914F6CDD1D);
        (res >> 11) as f64 / (1u64 << 53) as f64
    }
}

struct PlacedPiece {
    polygon: Vec<(f64, f64)>,
    bbox: (f64, f64, f64, f64),
}

struct Stock {
    placed: Vec<PlacedPiece>,
    used_area: f64,
}

fn cross_product(p0: (f64, f64), p1: (f64, f64), p2: (f64, f64)) -> f64 {
    (p1.0 - p0.0) * (p2.1 - p0.1) - (p1.1 - p0.1) * (p2.0 - p0.0)
}

fn segments_intersect(p1: (f64, f64), p2: (f64, f64), p3: (f64, f64), p4: (f64, f64)) -> bool {
    let cp1 = cross_product(p3, p4, p1);
    let cp2 = cross_product(p3, p4, p2);
    let cp3 = cross_product(p1, p2, p3);
    let cp4 = cross_product(p1, p2, p4);

    let eps = 1e-7;

    if ((cp1 > eps && cp2 < -eps) || (cp1 < -eps && cp2 > eps)) &&
       ((cp3 > eps && cp4 < -eps) || (cp3 < -eps && cp4 > eps)) {
        return true;
    }
    false
}

fn point_in_or_on_polygon(p: (f64, f64), poly: &[(f64, f64)]) -> bool {
    let mut inside = false;
    let mut j = poly.len() - 1;
    let eps = 1e-7;

    for i in 0..poly.len() {
        let pi = poly[i];
        let pj = poly[j];

        let min_x = pi.0.min(pj.0);
        let max_x = pi.0.max(pj.0);
        let min_y = pi.1.min(pj.1);
        let max_y = pi.1.max(pj.1);
        
        if p.0 >= min_x - eps && p.0 <= max_x + eps && p.1 >= min_y - eps && p.1 <= max_y + eps {
            let cp = (p.0 - pi.0) * (pj.1 - pi.1) - (p.1 - pi.1) * (pj.0 - pi.0);
            if cp.abs() < eps {
                return true;
            }
        }

        if (pi.1 > p.1) != (pj.1 > p.1) {
            let xinters = (pj.0 - pi.0) * (p.1 - pi.1) / (pj.1 - pi.1) + pi.0;
            if p.0 < xinters {
                inside = !inside;
            }
        }
        j = i;
    }
    inside
}

fn point_strictly_inside_polygon(p: (f64, f64), poly: &[(f64, f64)]) -> bool {
    let mut inside = false;
    let mut j = poly.len() - 1;
    let eps = 1e-7;

    for i in 0..poly.len() {
        let pi = poly[i];
        let pj = poly[j];

        let min_x = pi.0.min(pj.0);
        let max_x = pi.0.max(pj.0);
        let min_y = pi.1.min(pj.1);
        let max_y = pi.1.max(pj.1);
        
        if p.0 >= min_x - eps && p.0 <= max_x + eps && p.1 >= min_y - eps && p.1 <= max_y + eps {
            let cp = (p.0 - pi.0) * (pj.1 - pi.1) - (p.1 - pi.1) * (pj.0 - pi.0);
            if cp.abs() < eps {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if (pi.1 > p.1) != (pj.1 > p.1) {
            let xinters = (pj.0 - pi.0) * (p.1 - pi.1) / (pj.1 - pi.1) + pi.0;
            if p.0 < xinters {
                inside = !inside;
            }
        }
        j = i;
    }
    inside
}

fn any_point_strictly_inside(poly1: &[(f64, f64)], poly2: &[(f64, f64)]) -> bool {
    for p in poly1 {
        if point_strictly_inside_polygon(*p, poly2) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    false
}

fn polygons_overlap_fast(poly1: &[(f64, f64)], bb1: (f64, f64, f64, f64), placed: &PlacedPiece) -> bool {
    let bb2 = placed.bbox;
    let eps = 1e-7;
    if bb1.0 > bb2.1 - eps || bb1.1 < bb2.0 + eps || bb1.2 > bb2.3 - eps || bb1.3 < bb2.2 + eps {
        return false;
    }

    let poly2 = &placed.polygon;
    for i in 0..poly1.len() {
        let p1 = poly1[i];
        let p2 = poly1[(i + 1) % poly1.len()];
        for j in 0..poly2.len() {
            let p3 = poly2[j];
            let p4 = poly2[(j + 1) % poly2.len()];
            if segments_intersect(p1, p2, p3, p4) {
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    
    if any_point_strictly_inside(poly1, poly2) {
        return true;
    }
    if any_point_strictly_inside(poly2, poly1) {
        return true;
    }
    
    false
}

fn polygon_inside(inner: &[(f64, f64)], outer: &[(f64, f64)]) -> bool {
    let bbi = bounding_box(inner);
    let bbo = bounding_box(outer);
    let eps = 1e-7;
    if bbi.0 < bbo.0 - eps || bbi.1 > bbo.1 + eps || bbi.2 < bbo.2 - eps || bbi.3 > bbo.3 + eps {
        return false;
    }

    for p in inner {
        if !point_in_or_on_polygon(*p, outer) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    for i in 0..inner.len() {
        let p1 = inner[i];
        let p2 = inner[(i + 1) % inner.len()];
        for j in 0..outer.len() {
            let p3 = outer[j];
            let p4 = outer[(j + 1) % outer.len()];
            if segments_intersect(p1, p2, p3, p4) {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    true
}

fn bounding_box(poly: &[(f64, f64)]) -> (f64, f64, f64, f64) {
    let mut min_x = f64::MAX;
    let mut max_x = f64::MIN;
    let mut min_y = f64::MAX;
    let mut max_y = f64::MIN;
    for &(x, y) in poly {
        if x < min_x { min_x = x; }
        if x > max_x { max_x = x; }
        if y < min_y { min_y = y; }
        if y > max_y { max_y = y; }
    }
    (min_x, max_x, min_y, max_y)
}

fn polygon_area(poly: &[(f64, f64)]) -> f64 {
    let mut area = 0.0;
    for i in 0..poly.len() {
        let p1 = poly[i];
        let p2 = poly[(i + 1) % poly.len()];
        area += p1.0 * p2.1 - p2.0 * p1.1;
    }
    (area / 2.0).abs()
}

fn is_axis_aligned_rectangle(poly: &[(f64, f64)]) -> bool {
    if poly.len() != 4 {
        return false;
    }
    let mut xs = vec![poly[0].0, poly[1].0, poly[2].0, poly[3].0];
    let mut ys = vec![poly[0].1, poly[1].1, poly[2].1, poly[3].1];
    xs.sort_by(|a, b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap());
    ys.sort_by(|a, b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap());
    
    (xs[0] - xs[1]).abs() < 1e-7 && (xs[2] - xs[3]).abs() < 1e-7 &&
    (ys[0] - ys[1]).abs() < 1e-7 && (ys[2] - ys[3]).abs() < 1e-7
}

fn rotate_polygon(poly: &[(f64, f64)], rot: f64) -> Vec<(f64, f64)> {
    let cos_r = rot.cos();
    let sin_r = rot.sin();
    poly.iter().map(|&(x, y)| {
        (x * cos_r - y * sin_r, x * sin_r + y * cos_r)
    }).collect()
}

fn translate_polygon(poly: &[(f64, f64)], dx: f64, dy: f64) -> Vec<(f64, f64)> {
    poly.iter().map(|&(x, y)| (x + dx, y + dy)).collect()
}

fn try_place(
    piece: &[(f64, f64)], 
    stock_poly: &[(f64, f64)], 
    placed: &[PlacedPiece], 
    grid_res: usize, 
    rotations: &[f64],
    stock_is_rect: bool
) -> Option<(f64, f64, f64, Vec<(f64, f64)>)> {
    let (s_min_x, s_max_x, s_min_y, s_max_y) = bounding_box(stock_poly);
    
    let mut candidates = Vec::new();
    let mut rotated_polys = Vec::new();
    
    for (rot_idx, &rot) in rotations.iter().enumerate() {
        let rotated = rotate_polygon(piece, rot);
        let (p_min_x, p_max_x, p_min_y, p_max_y) = bounding_box(&rotated);
        
        rotated_polys.push(rotated);
        
        let dx_min = s_min_x - p_min_x;
        let dx_max = s_max_x - p_max_x;
        let dy_min = s_min_y - p_min_y;
        let dy_max = s_max_y - p_max_y;
        
        if dx_min > dx_max + 1e-7 || dy_min > dy_max + 1e-7 {
            continue;
        }
        
        let dx_max = dx_max.max(dx_min);
        let dy_max = dy_max.max(dy_min);
        
        for i in 0..=grid_res {
            let dx = if grid_res == 0 { dx_min } else { dx_min + (dx_max - dx_min) * (i as f64 / grid_res as f64) };
            for j in 0..=grid_res {
                let dy = if grid_res == 0 { dy_min } else { dy_min + (dy_max - dy_min) * (j as f64 / grid_res as f64) };
                candidates.push((dx, dy, rot_idx));
            }
        }
    }
    
    candidates.sort_by(|a, b| {
        a.1.partial_cmp(&b.1).unwrap().then(a.0.partial_cmp(&b.0).unwrap())
    });
    
    for (dx, dy, rot_idx) in candidates {
        let rot = rotations[rot_idx];
        let rotated = &rotated_polys[rot_idx];
        
        let mut inside_stock = true;
        let mut translated = Vec::new();
        
        if !stock_is_rect {
            translated = translate_polygon(rotated, dx, dy);
            inside_stock = polygon_inside(&translated, stock_poly);
        }
        
        if inside_stock {
            if translated.is_empty() {
                translated = translate_polygon(rotated, dx, dy);
            }
            let bb_trans = bounding_box(&translated);
            let mut overlap = false;
            for pl in placed {
                if polygons_overlap_fast(&translated, bb_trans, pl) {
                    overlap = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if !overlap {
                return Some((dx, dy, rot, translated));
            }
        }
    }
    None
}

fn place_in_existing_stocks(
    piece: &[(f64, f64)],
    piece_area: f64,
    stock_area: f64,
    stock_poly: &[(f64, f64)],
    stocks: &mut [Stock],
    stock_is_rect: bool
) -> Option<(usize, f64, f64, f64, Vec<(f64, f64)>)> {
    let rotations = [0.0, std::f64::consts::PI / 2.0, std::f64::consts::PI, 3.0 * std::f64::consts::PI / 2.0];
    
    let res = if stocks.len() < 5 {
        60
    } else if stocks.len() < 20 {
        40
    } else if stocks.len() < 100 {
        20
    } else if stocks.len() < 500 {
        10
    } else {
        5
    };
    
    for (i, stock) in stocks.iter().enumerate() {
        if stock.used_area + piece_area > stock_area {
            continue;
        }
        if let Some((dx, dy, rot, translated)) = try_place(piece, stock_poly, &stock.placed, res, &rotations, stock_is_rect) {
            return Some((i, dx, dy, rot, translated));
        }
    }
    None
}

fn place_in_new_stock(

        let dy_min = s_min_y - p_min_y;
        let dy_max = s_max_y - p_max_y;

}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace BinPackingSolver
{
    struct Vector3
    {
        public double X, Y, Z;
        public Vector3(double x, double y, double z) { X = x; Y = y; Z = z; }
    }

    struct Quaternion
    {
        public double W, X, Y, Z;
        public Quaternion(double w, double x, double y, double z) { W = w; X = x; Y = y; Z = z; }
        
        public static readonly Quaternion Identity = new Quaternion(1, 0, 0, 0);

        public Vector3 Rotate(Vector3 v)
        {
            double tx = 2 * (Y * v.Z - Z * v.Y);
            double ty = 2 * (Z * v.X - X * v.Z);
            double tz = 2 * (X * v.Y - Y * v.X);

            double rx = v.X + W * tx + (Y * tz - Z * ty);
            double ry = v.Y + W * ty + (Z * tx - X * tz);
            double rz = v.Z + W * tz + (X * ty - Y * tx);

            return new Vector3(rx, ry, rz);
        }

        public static Quaternion FromAxisAngle(Vector3 axis, double angle)
        {
            double halfAngle = angle * 0.5;
            double s = Math.Sin(halfAngle);
            return new Quaternion(Math.Cos(halfAngle), axis.X * s, axis.Y * s, axis.Z * s);
        }

        public static Quaternion Multiply(Quaternion q1, Quaternion q2)
        {
            return new Quaternion(
                q1.W * q2.W - q1.X * q2.X - q1.Y * q2.Y - q1.Z * q2.Z,
                q1.W * q2.X + q1.X * q2.W + q1.Y * q2.Z - q1.Z * q2.Y,
                q1.W * q2.Y - q1.X * q2.Z + q1.Y * q2.W + q1.Z * q2.X,
                q1.W * q2.Z + q1.X * q2.Y - q1.Y * q2.X + q1.Z * q2.W
            );
        }
    }

    class Polyhedron
    {
        public List<Vector3> Vertices;
    }

    class Scanner
    {
        private StreamReader _reader;
        private string[] _tokens = new string[0];
        private int _pos = 0;

        public Scanner(Stream stream)
        {
            _reader = new StreamReader(stream, new System.Text.UTF8Encoding(false), true, 65536);
        }

        public string Next()
        {
            while (_pos >= _tokens.Length)
            {
                string line = _reader.ReadLine();
                if (line == null) return null;
                _tokens = line.Split(new[] { ' ', '\t', '\r', '\n' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
                _pos = 0;
            }
            return _tokens[_pos++];
        }

        public double NextDouble()
        {
            return double.Parse(Next(), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        }
        
        public int NextInt()
        {
            return int.Parse(Next(), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        }
    }

    class Program
    {
        static void Main()
        {
            var scanner = new Scanner(Console.OpenStandardInput());
            
            string vStr = scanner.Next();
            if (vStr == null) return;
            
            int V = int.Parse(vStr, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            int F = scanner.NextInt();

            var poly = new Polyhedron { Vertices = new List<Vector3>(V) };
            for (int i = 0; i < V; i++)
            {
                poly.Vertices.Add(new Vector3(
                    scanner.NextDouble(),
                    scanner.NextDouble(),
                    scanner.NextDouble()
                ));
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < F; i++)
            {
                scanner.Next();
                scanner.Next();
                scanner.Next();
            }

            double W = scanner.NextDouble();
            double H = scanner.NextDouble();
            double D = scanner.NextDouble();

            double volume = W * H * D;

            List<Quaternion> rotations;
            if (volume < 50 * 50 * 50)
            {
                rotations = GenerateRotations(10); 
            }
            else if (volume < 150 * 150 * 150)
            {
                rotations = GenerateRotations(30); 
            }
            else
            {
                rotations = GenerateRotations(90); 
            }

            PackAndPrint(poly, W, H, D, rotations);
        }

        static List<Quaternion> GenerateRotations(int stepDegrees)
        {
            var rotations = new List<Quaternion>();
            for (int x = 0; x < 360; x += stepDegrees)
            {
                for (int y = 0; y < 360; y += stepDegrees)
                {
                    for (int z = 0; z < 360; z += stepDegrees)
                    {
                        Quaternion qx = Quaternion.FromAxisAngle(new Vector3(1, 0, 0), x * Math.PI / 180.0);
                        Quaternion qy = Quaternion.FromAxisAngle(new Vector3(0, 1, 0), y * Math.PI / 180.0);
                        Quaternion qz = Quaternion.FromAxisAngle(new Vector3(0, 0, 1), z * Math.PI / 180.0);
                        rotations.Add(Quaternion.Multiply(qx, Quaternion.Multiply(qy, qz)));
                    }
                }
            }
            return rotations;
        }

        static void PackAndPrint(Polyhedron poly, double W, double H, double D, List<Quaternion> rotations)
        {
            long bestCount = -1;
            Quaternion bestRot = Quaternion.Identity;
            double bestBw = 0, bestBh = 0, bestBd = 0;
            double bestMinX = 0, bestMinY = 0, bestMinZ = 0;

            object syncLock = new object();

            Parallel.ForEach(rotations, q =>
            {
                double minX = double.MaxValue, maxX = double.MinValue;
                double minY = double.MaxValue, maxY = double.MinValue;
                double minZ = double.MaxValue, maxZ = double.MinValue;

                foreach (var v in poly.Vertices)
                {
                    Vector3 rv = q.Rotate(v);
                    if (rv.X < minX) minX = rv.X;
                    if (rv.X > maxX) maxX = rv.X;
                    if (rv.Y < minY) minY = rv.Y;
                    if (rv.Y > maxY) maxY = rv.Y;
                    if (rv.Z < minZ) minZ = rv.Z;
                    if (rv.Z > maxZ) maxZ = rv.Z;
                }

                double bw = maxX - minX + 1e-9;
                double bh = maxY - minY + 1e-9;
                double bd = maxZ - minZ + 1e-9;

                if (bw > W || bh > H || bd > D) return;

                long countX = (long)(W / bw);
                long countY = (long)(H / bh);
                long countZ = (long)(D / bd);
                long count = countX * countY * countZ;

                lock (syncLock)
                {
                    if (count > bestCount)
                    {
                        bestCount = count;
                        bestRot = q;
                        bestBw = bw;
                        bestBh = bh;
                        bestBd = bd;
                        bestMinX = minX;
                        bestMinY = minY;
                        bestMinZ = minZ;
                    }
                }
            });

            if (bestCount <= 0)
            {
                Console.WriteLine(0);
                return;
            }

            long cX = (long)(W / bestBw);
            long cY = (long)(H / bestBh);
            long cZ = (long)(D / bestBd);

            using (var stdout = new StreamWriter(Console.OpenStandardOutput(), new System.Text.UTF8Encoding(false), 1048576))
            {
                stdout.WriteLine(bestCount);
                
                string rotStr = $"{bestRot.W.ToString("G17", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)} {bestRot.X.ToString("G17", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)} {bestRot.Y.ToString("G17", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)} {bestRot.Z.ToString("G17", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}";

                for (long i = 0; i < cX; i++)
                {
                    double tx = i * bestBw - bestMinX;
                    string txStr = tx.ToString("G17", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                    for (long j = 0; j < cY; j++)
                    {
                        double ty = j * bestBh - bestMinY;
                        string tyStr = ty.ToString("G17", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                        for (long k = 0; k < cZ; k++)
                        {
                            double tz = k * bestBd - bestMinZ;
                            stdout.WriteLine($"{txStr} {tyStr} {tz.ToString("G17", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)} {rotStr}");
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

#ifdef _MSC_VER
#include <intrin.h>
#pragma intrinsic(_umul128)
#endif

using namespace std;

// We use two hashes to simulate a collision-free 128-bit hash.
// Hash 1 uses modulo 2^61 - 1, Hash 2 uses 64-bit unsigned integer overflow.
const uint64_t MOD = (1ULL << 61) - 1;

// Fast modular multiplication using MSVC intrinsic if available.
inline uint64_t mul_mod(uint64_t a, uint64_t b) {
#ifdef _MSC_VER
    uint64_t high;
    uint64_t low = _umul128(a, b, &high);
    uint64_t c = (low & MOD) + (low >> 61) + (high << 3);
    c = (c & MOD) + (c >> 61);
    if (c >= MOD) c -= MOD;
    return c;
#else
    unsigned __int128 p = (unsigned __int128)a * b;
    uint64_t c = (uint64_t)(p >> 61) + (uint64_t)(p & MOD);
    if (c >= MOD) c -= MOD;
    return c;
#endif
}

inline uint64_t add_mod(uint64_t a, uint64_t b) {
    uint64_t c = a + b;
    if (c >= MOD) c -= MOD;
    return c;
}

inline uint64_t sub_mod(uint64_t a, uint64_t b) {
    uint64_t c = a + MOD - b;
    if (c >= MOD) c -= MOD;
    return c;
}

struct Hash128 {
    uint64_t h1; 
    uint64_t h2; 

    bool operator<(const Hash128& o) const {
        if (h1 != o.h1) return h1 < o.h1;
        return h2 < o.h2;
    }
    bool operator==(const Hash128& o) const {
        return h1 == o.h1 && h2 == o.h2;
    }
};

struct HashPos {
    Hash128 hash;
    uint32_t pos;
};

const uint64_t BASE1 = 313;
const uint64_t BASE2 = 317;

struct Solver {
    // 2^28 bits = 32MB Bloom filter to drastically reduce binary search lookups
    // This provides our adaptive logic: it gracefully scales down operations when
    // comparing against massive 10MB+ strings by pre-filtering candidate hashes.
    static constexpr uint32_t FILTER_BITS = 28;
    std::vector<HashPos> candidates;
    std::vector<HashPos> next_cands;
    std::vector<bool> found;
    std::vector<uint32_t> bloom;

    Solver() : bloom(1 << (FILTER_BITS - 5), 0) {}

    int Test(int L, const std::vector<std::string>& S) {
        if (L == 0) return -1;
        
        uint64_t P1 = 1, P2 = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < L; ++i) {
            P1 = mul_mod(P1, BASE1);
            P2 = P2 * BASE2;
        }

        candidates.clear();
        if (S[0].length() < (size_t)L) return -1;
        
        uint64_t h1 = 0, h2 = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < L; ++i) {
            uint8_t c = (uint8_t)S[0][i];
            h1 = add_mod(mul_mod(h1, BASE1), c);
            h2 = h2 * BASE2 + c;
        }
        candidates.push_back({{h1, h2}, 0});

        for (int i = L; i < (int)S[0].length(); ++i) {
            uint8_t c_in = (uint8_t)S[0][i];
            uint8_t c_out = (uint8_t)S[0][i-L];

            h1 = add_mod(mul_mod(h1, BASE1), c_in);
            uint64_t drop1 = mul_mod(c_out, P1);
            h1 = sub_mod(h1, drop1);

            h2 = h2 * BASE2 + c_in;
            uint64_t drop2 = c_out * P2;
            h2 = h2 - drop2;

            candidates.push_back({{h1, h2}, (uint32_t)(i - L + 1)});
        }

        std::sort(candidates.begin(), candidates.end(), [](const HashPos& a, const HashPos& b) {
            return a.hash < b.hash;
        });

        auto it = std::unique(candidates.begin(), candidates.end(), [](const HashPos& a, const HashPos& b) {
            return a.hash == b.hash;
        });
        candidates.erase(it, candidates.end());

        for (size_t k = 1; k < S.size(); ++k) {
            if (candidates.empty()) return -1;

            std::fill(bloom.begin(), bloom.end(), 0);
            for (const auto& c : candidates) {
                uint32_t idx_bloom = c.hash.h1 & ((1 << FILTER_BITS) - 1);
                bloom[idx_bloom >> 5] |= (1U << (idx_bloom & 31));
            }

            found.assign(candidates.size(), false);
            int num_found = 0;
            
            if (S[k].length() < (size_t)L) return -1;

            uint64_t ch1 = 0, ch2 = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < L; ++i) {
                uint8_t c = (uint8_t)S[k][i];
                ch1 = add_mod(mul_mod(ch1, BASE1), c);
                ch2 = ch2 * BASE2 + c;
            }
            
            auto check_and_mark = [&]() {
                uint32_t idx_bloom = ch1 & ((1 << FILTER_BITS) - 1);
                if (bloom[idx_bloom >> 5] & (1U << (idx_bloom & 31))) {
                    Hash128 cur = {ch1, ch2};
                    auto it = std::lower_bound(candidates.begin(), candidates.end(), HashPos{cur, 0}, [](const HashPos& a, const HashPos& b) {
                        return a.hash < b.hash;
                    });
                    if (it != candidates.end() && it->hash == cur) {
                        size_t idx = it - candidates.begin();
                        if (!found[idx]) {
                            found[idx] = true;
                            num_found++;
                        }
                    }
                }
            };
            
            check_and_mark();

            for (int i = L; i < (int)S[k].length(); ++i) {
                // Adaptive early exit: if all candidates found, skip rest of string
                if ((size_t)num_found == candidates.size()) break;

                uint8_t c_in = (uint8_t)S[k][i];
                uint8_t c_out = (uint8_t)S[k][i-L];

                ch1 = add_mod(mul_mod(ch1, BASE1), c_in);
                uint64_t drop1 = mul_mod(c_out, P1);
                ch1 = sub_mod(ch1, drop1);

                ch2 = ch2 * BASE2 + c_in;
                uint64_t drop2 = c_out * P2;
                ch2 = ch2 - drop2;

                check_and_mark();
            }

            next_cands.clear();
            for (size_t i = 0; i < candidates.size(); ++i) {
                if (found[i]) {
                    next_cands.push_back(candidates[i]);
                }
            }
            candidates = next_cands;
        }

        if (candidates.empty()) return -1;
        return candidates[0].pos;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    
    int N;
    if (!(cin >> N)) return 0;
    string dummy;
    getline(cin, dummy); // consume newline

    vector<string> S(N);
    for(int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        getline(cin, S[i]);
        // Handle Windows \r\n safely
        if (!S[i].empty() && S[i].back() == '\r') {
            S[i].pop_back();
        }
    }
    
    if (N == 0) {
        cout << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    if (N == 1) {
        cout << S[0] << "\n";
        return 0;
    }

    // Sort to optimize candidate extraction from the shortest string
    std::sort(S.begin(), S.end(), [](const string& a, const string& b) {
        return a.length() < b.length();
    });

    Solver solver;
    int low = 1, high = (int)S[0].length();
    int best_L = 0;
    int best_pos = -1;

    // Binary search over possible lengths
    while (low <= high) {
        int mid = low + (high - low) / 2;
        int pos = solver.Test(mid, S);
        if (pos != -1) {
            best_L = mid;
            best_pos = pos;
            low = mid + 1; // Try longer
        } else {
            high = mid - 1; // Try shorter
        }
    }

    if (best_L > 0) {
        cout << S[0].substr(best_pos, best_L) << "\n";
    } else {
        cout << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}

You are writing a Minesweeper solver in C# that must handle ANY board complexity from trivial to ludicrous scale.

- **Trivial**: Small boards (5x5-8x8), simple patterns, few mines
- **Extreme**: Massive boards (10000x10000), very complex constraint satisfaction problems

**Input format (stdin):**
Line 1: H W (height and width)
Next H lines: the board row strings (each W characters)

**Cell meanings:**
- ' ' (space): Unknown/unrevealed cell - could be mine or safe
- '0'-'8': Revealed safe cell showing count of adjacent mines (8 neighbors)
- '*': Flagged mine (known mine location)

**Output format (stdout):**
Line 1: N (number of safe cells found)
Next N lines: x y (column row, 0-indexed)
Only output cells that are currently unknown (' ') and provably safe.
Do NOT guess - only return cells you can prove are safe.

**Example:**
For a board where cell (0,0) shows '1' and has one adjacent mine at (1,0):
Neighbors (0,1) and (0,2) are guaranteed safe.

**Constraints:**
- Return as many provably safe cells as possible
- Never return a cell that could be a mine
- Must handle varying board sizes and mine densities efficiently

Given a partially-revealed Minesweeper board, deduce which hidden cells are safe to click and which contain mines. Each visible number tells you exactly how many of its neighbours are mined — the AI must combine these clues to make guaranteed-safe moves without guessing.

Larger boards and denser mine layouts make the logic harder. The problem is NP-complete in general, but clever constraint reasoning can solve most practical boards. The baseline uses only the simplest single-cell deduction rules.

Minesweeper Solver - 8x8 board, 10 mines

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;

class MinesweeperSolver
{
    static int H, W;
    static byte[] board;
    static bool[] inQueue;
    static Queue<int> queue;
    static List<int> newSafes = new List<int>();

    static void Main()
    {
        using (Stream s = Console.OpenStandardInput())
        {
            FastScanner scanner = new FastScanner(s);
            H = scanner.ReadInt();
            W = scanner.ReadInt();
            if (H == 0 || W == 0) return;
            board = new byte[H * W];
            inQueue = new bool[H * W];
            queue = new Queue<int>(Math.Min(10000000, H * W / 4 + 100)); 
            
            int expected = H * W;
            int idx = 0;
            while(idx < expected)
            {
                int c = scanner.ReadByte();
                if (c == -1) break;
                if (c == ' ') board[idx++] = 9;
                else if (c == '*') board[idx++] = 10;
                else if (c >= '0' && c <= '8') board[idx++] = (byte)(c - '0');
            }
        }

        // Initialize queue with all active number cells
        for (int i = 0; i < H * W; i++)
        {
            if (board[i] <= 8)
            {
                int unkCount = 0;
                int[] unks = new int[8];
                GetNeighborsInfo(i, out unks, out unkCount, out int mineCount);
                if (unkCount > 0)
                {
                    queue.Enqueue(i);
                    inQueue[i] = true;
                }
            }
        }

        List<int> activeBorder = new List<int>();
        bool changed = true;
        
        while (changed)
        {
            changed = false;
            activeBorder.Clear();
            
            // 1. Trivial Phase
            while (queue.Count > 0)
            {
                int p = queue.Dequeue();
                inQueue[p] = false;
                
                if (board[p] > 8) continue;
                
                GetNeighborsInfo(p, out int[] unks, out int unkCount, out int mineCount);
                if (unkCount == 0) continue;
                
                int req = board[p] - mineCount;
                if (req == 0)
                {
                    for (int i = 0; i < unkCount; i++) MarkSafe(unks[i]);
                    changed = true;
                }
                else if (req == unkCount)
                {
                    for (int i = 0; i < unkCount; i++) MarkMine(unks[i]);
                    changed = true;
                }
                else
                {
                    activeBorder.Add(p);
                }
            }
            
            if (changed) continue;

            // Clean activeBorder before Subset Phase
            List<int> cleanBorder = new List<int>();
            foreach (int p in activeBorder)
            {
                if (board[p] <= 8)
                {
                    GetNeighborsInfo(p, out int[] _, out int uc, out int _);
                    if (uc > 0) cleanBorder.Add(p);
                }
            }
            activeBorder = cleanBorder;

            if (activeBorder.Count == 0) break;

            // 2. Subset Phase
            bool subsetFound = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < activeBorder.Count; i++)
            {
                int p = activeBorder[i];
                GetNeighborsInfo(p, out int[] unksP, out int unkCountP, out int mineCountP);
                if (unkCountP == 0) continue;
                int reqP = board[p] - mineCountP;

                int[] qs = new int[64];
                int qCount = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < unkCountP; j++)
                {
                    int[] qCands = GetNumberNeighbors(unksP[j], out int cCount);
                    for (int k = 0; k < cCount; k++)
                    {
                        int q = qCands[k];
                        if (q != p)
                        {
                            bool present = false;
                            for (int m = 0; m < qCount; m++) if (qs[m] == q) { present = true; break; }
                            if (!present) qs[qCount++] = q;
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                for (int k = 0; k < qCount; k++)
                {
                    int q = qs[k];
                    GetNeighborsInfo(q, out int[] unksQ, out int unkCountQ, out int mineCountQ);
                    int reqQ = board[q] - mineCountQ;
                    
                    if (unkCountP > 0 && unkCountP < unkCountQ && IsSubset(unksP, unkCountP, unksQ, unkCountQ))
                    {
                        int diffReq = reqQ - reqP;
                        int diffUnk = unkCountQ - unkCountP;
                        
                        if (diffReq == 0)
                        {
                            for(int j = 0; j < unkCountQ; j++)
                            {
                                if (!Contains(unksP, unkCountP, unksQ[j]))
                                {
                                    MarkSafe(unksQ[j]);
                                    subsetFound = true;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        else if (diffReq == diffUnk)
                        {
                            for(int j = 0; j < unkCountQ; j++)
                            {
                                if (!Contains(unksP, unkCountP, unksQ[j]))
                                {
                                    MarkMine(unksQ[j]);
                                    subsetFound = true;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (subsetFound) break;
            }
            
            if (subsetFound)
            {
                changed = true;
                continue;
            }

            // 3. CSP Phase
            if (RunCSP(activeBorder))
            {
                changed = true;
                continue;
            }
        }
        
        // Output results
        newSafes.Sort();
        using (StreamWriter writer = new StreamWriter(Console.OpenStandardOutput(), new System.Text.UTF8Encoding(false), 65536))
        {
            writer.WriteLine(newSafes.Count);
            foreach (int s in newSafes)
            {
                writer.WriteLine($"{s % W} {s / W}");
            }
        }
    }

    static void MarkSafe(int p)
    {
        if (board[p] == 11 || board[p] == 10) return;
        board[p] = 11;
        newSafes.Add(p);
        
        int[] nums = GetNumberNeighbors(p, out int numCount);
        for (int i = 0; i < numCount; i++)
        {
            int q = nums[i];
            if (!inQueue[q])
            {
                queue.Enqueue(q);
                inQueue[q] = true;
            }
        }
    }

    static void MarkMine(int p)
    {
        if (board[p] == 11 || board[p] == 10) return;
        board[p] = 10;
        
        int[] nums = GetNumberNeighbors(p, out int numCount);
        for (int i = 0; i < numCount; i++)
        {
            int q = nums[i];
            if (!inQueue[q])
            {
                queue.Enqueue(q);
                inQueue[q] = true;
            }
        }
    }

    static void GetNeighborsInfo(int p, out int[] unks, out int unkCount, out int mineCount)
    {
        unks = new int[8];
        unkCount = 0;
        mineCount = 0;
        int y = p / W;
        int x = p % W;
        for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++)
        {
            for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++)
            {
                if (dy == 0 && dx == 0) continue;
                int ny = y + dy;
                int nx = x + dx;
                if (ny >= 0 && ny < H && nx >= 0 && nx < W)
                {
                    int np = ny * W + nx;
                    byte val = board[np];
                    if (val == 9) unks[unkCount++] = np;
                    else if (val == 10) mineCount++;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[] GetNumberNeighbors(int p, out int numCount)
    {
        int[] nums = new int[8];
        numCount = 0;
        int y = p / W;
        int x = p % W;
        for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++)
        {
            for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++)
            {
                if (dy == 0 && dx == 0) continue;
                int ny = y + dy;
                int nx = x + dx;
                if (ny >= 0 && ny < H && nx >= 0 && nx < W)
                {
                    int np = ny * W + nx;
                    byte val = board[np];
                    if (val <= 8) nums[numCount++] = np;
                }
            }
        }
        return nums;
    }

    static bool Contains(int[] arr, int count, int val)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) if (arr[i] == val) return true;
        return false;
    }

    static bool IsSubset(int[] sub, int subCount, int[] super, int superCount)
    {
        if (subCount > superCount) return false;
        for (int i = 0; i < subCount; i++)
        {
            bool found = false;
            for (int j = 0; j < superCount; j++)
            {
                if (sub[i] == super[j]) { found = true; break; }
            }
            if (!found) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static bool RunCSP(List<int> activeNumbers)
    {
        HashSet<int> activeUnknowns = new HashSet<int>();
        foreach (int p in activeNumbers)
        {
            GetNeighborsInfo(p, out int[] unks, out int unkCount, out int _);
            for (int i = 0; i < unkCount; i++) activeUnknowns.Add(unks[i]);
        }

        if (activeUnknowns.Count == 0) return false;

        Dictionary<int, List<int>> unkToNum = new Dictionary<int, List<int>>();
        foreach (int u in activeUnknowns)
        {
            unkToNum[u] = new List<int>();
            int[] nums = GetNumberNeighbors(u, out int numCount);
            for(int i = 0; i < numCount; i++)
            {
                unkToNum[u].Add(nums[i]);
            }
        }
        
        HashSet<int> visitedUnknowns = new HashSet<int>();
        bool cspFoundAny = false;

        foreach (int startU in activeUnknowns)
        {
            if (visitedUnknowns.Contains(startU)) continue;

            List<int> compU = new List<int>();
            HashSet<int> compE = new HashSet<int>();
            
            Queue<int> qCSP = new Queue<int>();
            qCSP.Enqueue(startU);
            visitedUnknowns.Add(startU);

            while (qCSP.Count > 0)
            {
                int u = qCSP.Dequeue();
                compU.Add(u);
                
                foreach (int e in unkToNum[u])
                {
                    if (compE.Add(e)) 
                    {
                        GetNeighborsInfo(e, out int[] unks, out int unkCount, out int _);
                        for (int i = 0; i < unkCount; i++)
                        {
                            int nextU = unks[i];
                            if (visitedUnknowns.Add(nextU))
                            {
                                qCSP.Enqueue(nextU);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            bool found = SolveComponent(compU, compE.ToList());
            if (found) cspFoundAny = true;
        }

        return cspFoundAny;
    }

    static bool SolveComponent(List<int> U, List<int> E)
    {
        int uCount = U.Count;
        int eCount = E.Count;
        
        if (uCount > 150) return false;

        List<int>[] eqVars = new List<int>[eCount];
        int[] req = new int[eCount];
        List<int>[] varEqs = new List<int>[uCount];

        Dictionary<int, int> uMap = new Dictionary<int, int>();
        for (int i = 0; i < uCount; i++)
        {
            uMap[U[i]] = i;
            varEqs[i] = new List<int>();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < eCount; i++)
        {
            int e = E[i];
            eqVars[i] = new List<int>();
            GetNeighborsInfo(e, out int[] unks, out int unkCount, out int mineCount);
            req[i] = board[e] - mineCount;
            
            for (int j = 0; j < unkCount; j++)
            {
                if (uMap.TryGetValue(unks[j], out int varIdx))
                {
                    eqVars[i].Add(varIdx);
                    varEqs[varIdx].Add(i);
                }
            }
        }

        int[] currentSum = new int[eCount];
        int[] remainingVars = new int[eCount];
        for (int i = 0; i < eCount; i++) remainingVars[i] = eqVars[i].Count;

        int validSolutions = 0;
        int[] minVarPossible = new int[uCount];
        int[] maxVarPossible = new int[uCount];
        for (int i = 0; i < uCount; i++)
        {
            minVarPossible[i] = 1;
            maxVarPossible[i] = 0;
        }
        int[] currentAssignment = new int[uCount];

        int nodesVisited = 0;
        bool abort = false;

        int[] varOrder = new int[uCount];
        for(int i = 0; i < uCount; i++) varOrder[i] = i;
        Array.Sort(varOrder, (a, b) => varEqs[b].Count.CompareTo(varEqs[a].Count));
        
        void SolveIndir(int depth)
        {
            if (abort) return;
            nodesVisited++;
            if (nodesVisited > 200000) { abort = true; return; }

            if (depth == uCount)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < eCount; i++)
                    if (currentSum[i] != req[i]) return;

                validSolutions++;
                for (int i = 0; i < uCount; i++)
                {
                    if (currentAssignment[i] == 1) maxVarPossible[i] = 1;
                    else minVarPossible[i] = 0;
                }
                return;
            }

            int varIdx = varOrder[depth];

            bool canAssign0 = true;
            foreach (int eIdx in varEqs[varIdx])
            {
                if (currentSum[eIdx] + remainingVars[eIdx] - 1 < req[eIdx])
                {
                    canAssign0 = false; break;
                }
            }

            if (canAssign0)
            {
                foreach (int eIdx in varEqs[varIdx]) remainingVars[eIdx]--;
                currentAssignment[varIdx] = 0;
                SolveIndir(depth + 1);
                foreach (int eIdx in varEqs[varIdx]) remainingVars[eIdx]++;
            }

            bool canAssign1 = true;
            foreach (int eIdx in varEqs[varIdx])
            {
                if (currentSum[eIdx] + 1 > req[eIdx])
                {
                    canAssign1 = false; break;
                }
            }

            if (canAssign1)
            {
                foreach (int eIdx in varEqs[varIdx])
                {
                    remainingVars[eIdx]--;
                    currentSum[eIdx]++;
                }
                currentAssignment[varIdx] = 1;
                SolveIndir(depth + 1);
                foreach (int eIdx in varEqs[varIdx])
                {
                    remainingVars[eIdx]++;
                    currentSum[eIdx]--;
                }
            }
        }

        SolveIndir(0);

        if (abort || validSolutions == 0) return false;

        bool foundAny = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < uCount; i++)
        {
            if (maxVarPossible[i] == 0)
            {
                MarkSafe(U[i]);
                foundAny = true;
            }
            else if (minVarPossible[i] == 1)
            {
                MarkMine(U[i]);
                foundAny = true;
            }
        }

        return foundAny;
    }

    class FastScanner
    {
        Stream s;
        byte[] buf = new byte[1024 * 1024];
        int head = 0, tail = 0;

        public FastScanner(Stream stream) { s = stream; }

        public int ReadByte()
        {
            if (head >= tail)
            {
                head = 0;
                tail = s.Read(buf, 0, buf.Length);
                if (tail == 0) return -1;
            }
            return buf[head++];
        }
        
        public int ReadInt()
        {
            int res = 0;
            bool started = false;
            while (true)
            {
                int c = ReadByte();
                if (c == -1) return res;
                if (c >= '0' && c <= '9')
                {
                    res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
                    started = true;
                }
                else if (started) break;
            }
            return res;
        }
    }
}

You are solving a Shadow Covering problem with tetrahedrons in Rust.

**The Challenge:**
Your program will be tested with polygons ranging from simple shapes to very complex geometries.
The same program must work efficiently across ALL scales.

**Input format (stdin):**
Line 1: NV (number of polygon vertices)
Next NV lines: x y (polygon vertices on z=0 plane)
Last line: sx sy sz (sun direction vector, points from sun toward ground)

**Output format (stdout):**
Line 1: count (number of tetrahedrons)
Next count lines: px py pz qw qx qy qz scale
px,py,pz: center position
qw,qx,qy,qz: rotation quaternion (w is scalar)
scale: uniform scale factor

**Standard Tetrahedron Reference:**
Vertices (before transform):
[1.0, 0.0, -0.707]
[-1.0, 0.0, -0.707]
[0.0, 1.0, 0.707]
[0.0, -1.0, 0.707]

**Constraints:**
- Combined shadows must completely cover target polygon
- Tetrahedrons must not intersect each other in 3D
- Maximum scale factor per tetrahedron: 10.0
- Minimize number of tetrahedrons

**Environment:**
Platform: Windows 11 (build 10.0.26200)
Architecture: AMD64
CPU: AMD64 Family 23 Model 8 Stepping 2, AuthenticAMD
Core count: 64

use std::io::Read;

fn main() {
    let mut input = String::new();
    if std::io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut input).is_err() {
        return;
    }
    let mut tokens = input.split_whitespace();

    let nv_str = tokens.next();
    if nv_str.is_none() { return; }
    let nv: usize = nv_str.unwrap().parse().unwrap();

    let mut vertices = Vec::new();
    for _ in 0..nv {
        let x: f64 = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
        let y: f64 = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
        vertices.push((x, y));
    }

    let sx: f64 = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
    let sy: f64 = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
    let sz: f64 = tokens.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();

    if nv < 3 {
        println!("0");
        return;
    }

    let norm = (sx * sx + sy * sy + sz * sz).sqrt();
    let nx = -sx / norm;
    let ny = -sy / norm;
    let nz = -sz / norm;

    let mut qw = 1.0 + nz;
    let mut qx = -ny;
    let mut qy = nx;
    let mut qz = 0.0;

    let qnorm = (qw * qw + qx * qx + qy * qy + qz * qz).sqrt();
    if qnorm < 1e-8 {
        qw = 0.0;
        qx = 1.0;
        qy = 0.0;
        qz = 0.0;
    } else {
        qw /= qnorm;
        qx /= qnorm;
        qy /= qnorm;
        qz /= qnorm;
    }

    let x_loc_x = 1.0 - 2.0 * qy * qy - 2.0 * qz * qz;
    let x_loc_y = 2.0 * qx * qy + 2.0 * qz * qw;
    let x_loc_z = 2.0 * qx * qz - 2.0 * qy * qw;

    let y_loc_x = 2.0 * qx * qy - 2.0 * qz * qw;
    let y_loc_y = 1.0 - 2.0 * qx * qx - 2.0 * qz * qz;
    let y_loc_z = 2.0 * qy * qz + 2.0 * qx * qw;

    let s = 10.0;
    let u_x = s * (x_loc_x - x_loc_z * sx / sz);
    let u_y = s * (x_loc_y - x_loc_z * sy / sz);
    let v_x = s * (y_loc_x - y_loc_z * sx / sz);
    let v_y = s * (y_loc_y - y_loc_z * sy / sz);

    let t1_x = u_x + v_x;
    let t1_y = u_y + v_y;
    let t2_x = u_x - v_x;
    let t2_y = u_y - v_y;

    let d = t1_x * t2_y - t1_y * t2_x;

    let mut a_raw_vals = Vec::with_capacity(nv);
    let mut b_raw_vals = Vec::with_capacity(nv);
    for &(x, y) in &vertices {
        let a = (x * t2_y - y * t2_x) / d;
        let b = (-x * t1_y + y * t1_x) / d;
        a_raw_vals.push(a);
        b_raw_vals.push(b);
    }

    let min_a_raw = a_raw_vals.iter().copied().fold(f64::INFINITY, f64::min);
    let min_b_raw = b_raw_vals.iter().copied().fold(f64::INFINITY, f64::min);

    let a_offset = min_a_raw + 0.5 - 2e-7;
    let b_offset = min_b_raw + 0.5 - 2e-7;

    let mut p = Vec::with_capacity(nv);
    for i in 0..nv {
        p.push((a_raw_vals[i] - a_offset, b_raw_vals[i] - b_offset));
    }

    let min_b = p.iter().map(|v| v.1).fold(f64::INFINITY, f64::min);
    let max_b = p.iter().map(|v| v.1).fold(f64::NEG_INFINITY, f64::max);

    let j_min = (min_b - 0.5).floor() as i32;
    let j_max = (max_b + 0.5).ceil() as i32;

    let mut cells = Vec::new();

    for j in j_min..=j_max {
        let mut l_intervals = Vec::new();
        let mut intersections = Vec::new();

        for k in 0..nv {
            let p1 = p[k];
            let p2 = p[(k + 1) % nv];
            let min_y = p1.1.min(p2.1);
            let max_y = p1.1.max(p2.1);

            if min_y <= j as f64 && max_y > j as f64 {
                let t = (j as f64 - p1.1) / (p2.1 - p1.1);
                let a_int = p1.0 + t * (p2.0 - p1.0);
                intersections.push(a_int);
            }
        }

        intersections.sort_by(|x, y| x.partial_cmp(y).unwrap());
        for m in 0..intersections.len() / 2 {
            l_intervals.push((intersections[2 * m], intersections[2 * m + 1]));
        }

        for k in 0..nv {
            let p1 = p[k];
            let p2 = p[(k + 1) % nv];
            let min_y = p1.1.min(p2.1);
            let max_y = p1.1.max(p2.1);

            if max_y >= j as f64 - 0.5 && min_y <= j as f64 + 0.5 {
                if (p1.1 - p2.1).abs() < 1e-9 {
                    l_intervals.push((p1.0.min(p2.0), p1.0.max(p2.0)));
                } else {
                    let t_min = (j as f64 - 0.5 - p1.1) / (p2.1 - p1.1);
                    let t_max = (j as f64 + 0.5 - p1.1) / (p2.1 - p1.1);
                    let t_enter = t_min.min(t_max).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                    let t_leave = t_min.max(t_max).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                    if t_enter <= t_leave {
                        let c1 = p1.0 + t_enter * (p2.0 - p1.0);
                        let c2 = p1.0 + t_leave * (p2.0 - p1.0);
                        l_intervals.push((c1.min(c2), c1.max(c2)));
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        l_intervals.sort_by(|x, y| x.0.partial_cmp(&y.0).unwrap());
        let mut merged: Vec<(f64, f64)> = Vec::new();
        for interval in l_intervals {
            if let Some(last) = merged.last_mut() {
                if interval.0 <= last.1 + 1e-6 {
                    last.1 = last.1.max(interval.1);
                } else {
                    merged.push(interval);
                }
            } else {
                merged.push(interval);
            }
        }

        for interval in merged {
            let a_val = interval.0 - 1e-7;
            let b_val = interval.1 + 1e-7;
            let i_start = (a_val + 0.5).floor() as i32;
            let i_end = (b_val - 0.5).ceil() as i32;
            for i in i_start..=i_end {
                cells.push((i, j));
            }
        }
    }

    cells.sort_unstable();
    cells.dedup();

    println!("{}", cells.len());
    for (idx, &(i, j)) in cells.iter().enumerate() {
        let a_raw = i as f64 + a_offset;
        let b_raw = j as f64 + b_offset;

        let c_prime_x = a_raw * t1_x + b_raw * t2_x;
        let c_prime_y = a_raw * t1_y + b_raw * t2_y;

        let c_z = (idx as f64) * 20.0 + 20.0;
        let c_x = c_prime_x + c_z * sx / sz;
        let c_y = c_prime_y + c_z * sy / sz;

        println!("{} {} {} {:.6} {:.6} {:.6} {:.6} 10.0", c_x, c_y, c_z, qw, qx, qy, qz);
    }
}

You are solving a Job-Shop Scheduling problem in C++.

You must write a C++ solver that can handle ANY problem size from trivial to extremely large scale:
- **Trivial**: 2-3 jobs, 2-3 machines, 5-10 tasks total
- **Extreme**: 1000+ jobs, 50+ machines, 50k+ tasks total

**Input format (stdin):**

**Output format (stdout):**

(Job 0: task 0 starts at t=0 on M0, task 1 at t=3 on M1)

**Key Constraints:**

2. Tasks within a job must execute in order (task i before task i+1)
3. A machine can only run one task at a time

Schedule a set of jobs across several machines to finish everything as quickly as possible. Each job is a sequence of tasks that must run in order, and each task needs a specific machine — but a machine can only do one thing at a time.

This classic factory-scheduling problem is NP-hard. Subpasses increase the number of jobs and machines. The baseline greedily starts whichever task can begin earliest.
